descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Job Description

Position Location:
This is a Flexible (Hybrid) position.  Flexible positions require 2 days per week in a ServiceNow office location.  We have offices in several locations, including San Francisco, CA; Pleasanton, CA; Santa Clara, CA; San Diego, CA; and Kirkland, WA

Please Note:This position will include supporting our US Regulated Markets.
“This position requires passing a ServiceNow background screening, USFedPASS (US Federal Personnel Authorization Screening Standards). This includes a credit check, criminal/misdemeanor check and taking a drug test. Any employment is contingent upon passing the screening.  Due to Federal requirements, only US citizens, US naturalized citizens or US Permanent Residents, holding a green card, will be considered.


About the team:
We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer (IC5 Level) to join our Data Platform Engineering organization.   You will be a hands-on technical lead who will lead the design and delivery of shared, multi-tenant platform services — Postgres, queueing/streaming, and key-value stores — on Kubernetes, and serves as the technical anchor for their availability, resilience, and operating model.

What you get to do in this role:

  • You will lead the design and delivery of shared platform services — managed Postgres, queueing/streaming, and key-value/cache — that run on Kubernetes across a large global fleet and that product teams across the company depend on, owning them from design through production operation.
  • You will act as the technical lead on major initiatives within your team, breaking down ambiguous problems — “offer HA Postgres as a service to every cluster,” “make our queueing tier survive a zone loss” — into clear, executable designs with explicit availability, durability, and cost targets.
  • You will define the HA, failover, disaster-recovery, and multi-region architecture for the services you own, and the Kubernetes-native automation (operators, controllers, CRDs, self-service APIs) that provisions, scales, upgrades, and fails them over without human intervention.
  • You will partner with principal and distinguished engineers to align your work with the broader platform architecture and standards, and with product teams to set consumption contracts, tenancy models, and SLOs for shared services.
  • You will identify technical risks early and drive them to resolution, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and operability — leading failure-mode analysis, game days, and post-incident reviews for stateful systems.
  • You will spend significant time hands-on — designing, coding, and reviewing the core systems your team builds, such as operators, controllers, infrastructure automation, and platform services.
  • You will mentor mid-level and junior engineers and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design feedback, and pairing — particularly around distributed-systems and data-service design.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work — whether using AI-powered tooling, automating operational workflows, building agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run.
  • 12+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree; OR 8+ years with a Master's degree; OR 5+ years with a PhD; OR equivalent work experience.
  • 8+ years building production software, with solid experience operating distributed systems and running stateful workloads on Kubernetes at scale.
  • A track record of leading the design and delivery of at least one shared, multi-tenant infrastructure service used broadly by other teams — a relational database service (Postgres or similar), a message queue or streaming platform (Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar), or a key-value/cache service (Redis/Valkey, etcd, or similar) — including its HA, failover, and operating model.
  • Deep understanding of high availability and failure handling: replication topologies, leader election, quorum and consensus, split-brain avoidance, backup/restore and point-in-time recovery, and designing to explicit RPO/RTO and durability targets.
  • Strong system design skills — you can reason rigorously about consistency models, partitioning and rebalancing, capacity planning, tenant isolation, and noisy-neighbor mitigation, and communicate the trade-offs clearly to engineers and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP), including its core compute, networking, storage, and IAM primitives.
  • Strong working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes (including stateful primitives: StatefulSets, CSI/persistent storage, PDBs, topology spread), CI/CD and GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Strong programming skills in Go (or strong systems-language skills with a willingness to work primarily in Go).

It also helps if you have:

  • Experience building or extending Kubernetes operators that manage stateful systems (e.g., CloudNativePG, Zalando/Crunchy Postgres operators, Strimzi, Redis/Valkey operators), and opinions on when to adopt versus build.
  • Deep expertise in one of the target systems: Postgres internals (WAL, streaming/logical replication, vacuum, connection pooling with PgBouncer/PgCat, major-version upgrades); Kafka/NATS (partitioning, ISR/replication, exactly-once semantics, consumer scaling); or Redis/Valkey (cluster mode, persistence, eviction, hot-key handling).
  • Experience running data services across multiple regions or clusters — cross-region replication, failover orchestration, and DR testing.
  • Experience with zero-downtime upgrades, schema/data migrations, and fleet-wide rollouts of stateful services.
  • Experience with observability and SLOs for stateful systems — replication lag, saturation, tail latency, error budgets — and with capacity and cost management for shared infrastructure.
  • Experience designing multi-tenancy: quotas, isolation, chargeback/showback, and self-service provisioning APIs or CRDs.
  • Experience with container networking (CNI) and/or service mesh, and with workload identity, mTLS, and secrets management as applied to data services.
  • Experience with managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), managed data services (RDS/Aurora, Cloud SQL, MSK, ElastiCache), and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Crossplane.

descriptionHtml:

Armis from ServiceNow protects the full attack surface and helps organizations manage cyber risk exposure in real time. Together with ServiceNow Security and Risk capabilities and Identity Security capabilities from Veza, Armis helps secure every asset and identity, including AI agents, across complex environments. The result is a foundation for autonomous defense for the Agentic Enterprise, grounded in security, operational, and business context. 

Job Description

As a Sr. Manager, Solution Consulting (Operational Technology and Cyber-Physical Systems, OT/CPS), you will lead a global team of Solution Consultants focused on ServiceNow's OT/CPS portfolio, including Armis OT visibility and security, Cyber Asset Security, and USEM for OT. This is a player-coach role: you will set the technical pre-sales strategy, develop a high-performing team, and personally engage in the most strategic customer opportunities. 

Success in this role means scaling ServiceNow's OT/CPS business by building a world-class solution consulting team, improving the quality and consistency of technical sales execution, and helping customers connect industrial operations, cyber risk, and business impact across complex environments. 

What you'll do... 

Team leadership and talent evaluation 

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a global team of OT Solution Consultants, providing coaching, feedback, and career development. 
  • Evaluate Solution Consultants against a consistent skills framework that measures OT and ICS technical depth, asset visibility and exposure management expertise, demo and storytelling craft, discovery quality, business value articulation, and AI fluency. 
  • Use those assessments to build individual development plans, identify coverage gaps, recommend staffing and role changes, and inform hiring, bench strength, and succession planning. 
  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Enablement, and Talent teams to calibrate expectations, recognize top performance, and address underperformance early. 
  • Set performance goals, track progress, and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture across the broader Solution Consulting community. 

AI-native leadership 

  • Model AI-native ways of working in account research, discovery preparation, demo and proof-of-value design, proposal support, pipeline inspection, and team coaching. 
  • Set clear expectations that every SC uses AI to improve the quality, speed, and consistency of their work, and measure adoption through practical indicators such as reusable assets created, preparation quality, demo effectiveness, and time saved. 
  • Build and share reusable AI assets, including prompts, agents, skills, demo scripts, and playbooks, that scale OT/CPS expertise across regions and verticals. 
  • Coach SCs to position the ServiceNow AI platform and agentic capabilities credibly with OT, security, and operations buyers, including AI governance and safety in industrial environments. 
  • Stay current on AI developments and bring practical improvements to how the team sells, demonstrates, and delivers value. 

Sales support and strategy 

  • Partner with Account Executives, Armis and Veza specialists, and OT sales leadership to qualify, shape, and win complex OT/CPS opportunities. 
  • Provide technical leadership through discovery, demonstrations, proofs of value, RFP responses, and executive presentations. 
  • Develop deep expertise in the OT/CPS portfolio and explain how it connects to ServiceNow ITOM, Security and Risk, workflow capabilities, and Armis OT visibility and security in customer-specific use cases. 
  • Help define go-to-market plays, vertical strategies (energy and utilities, manufacturing, life sciences, oil and gas, transportation), and sales collateral. 

Customer engagement 

  • Engage directly with CISOs, OT security leaders, plant and operations leaders, and architects to understand technical requirements, operational constraints, regulatory pressures, and the business outcomes customers need to achieve. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor on OT security, compliance, and risk reduction, including frameworks such as NIS2, NERC CIP, IEC 62443, and CIRCIA. 
  • Conduct customer site visits, workshops, and executive briefings, and deliver demonstrations and proofs of value that connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational resilience, and measurable business impact. 

Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Provide structured field feedback to Product Management on features, competitive gaps, and market demand. 
  • Work with Marketing and Enablement to develop technical content, case studies, and field-ready tools. 
  • Coordinate with Services, Partners, and Customer Success for a smooth transition from sale to implementation. 

Continuous improvement 

  • Track the OT security competitive landscape and emerging industrial technologies. 
  • Identify process improvements and best practices to scale the Solution Consulting function. 
  • Report on team performance, coverage, and AI adoption to senior leadership. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • A bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent work experience. 
  • Proven experience in solution consulting, sales engineering, or technical sales, preferably in cybersecurity, OT/ICS security, or industrial technology. 
  • Experience managing and developing technical pre-sales teams, including assessing talent, setting standards, and coaching to improve. 
  • Deep knowledge of OT/ICS environments, protocols, and architectures, including the Purdue model and segmentation, as well as OT security and asset visibility. 
  • Familiarity with OT regulatory and standards frameworks (NIS2, NERC CIP, IEC 62443, CIRCIA, etc.). 
  • A demonstrated AI-native mindset: hands-on use of generative and agentic AI in your own work, and a track record of driving AI adoption on a team. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences. 
  • A strong customer focus and the ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders. 
  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to drive decisions. 
  • A proactive, self-driven approach in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time on average. 

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay range of $175,000-$210,000, plus equity when applicable, variable or incentive compensation, and benefits. Sales positions generally include a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. The base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. Benefits include health plans, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan, and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location of the role and may change based on work location.

You'll collaborate closely with machine learning experts and cross-functional teams, rapidly iterating over new ideas, and leveraging user behavior data to make informed decisions. Your challenge will be to scale and optimize our conversation engine to support hundreds of millions of users, across multiple chat channels and use cases, and enhance our end-to-end product infrastructure with the utmost engineering quality and robustness.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Construct an extensive product infrastructure, complete with user-friendly interfaces that empower engineers and configurators to effortlessly customize and optimize generative AI models. This includes collecting data and feedback, adapting to diverse enterprise use cases and business contexts, and delivering domain-specific conversational experiences.
  • Design scalable API abstractions for our conversation platform, which supports all popular chat clients (for example, MSTeams, Slack, and Web) and offers a neutral API for developing other parts of the engineering system.
  • Optimize the dialog engine to accommodate a wide range of conversational features, leveraging private domain knowledge unique to each enterprise customer in the cloud, and enable real-time multilingual translation. You will achieve this with minimal memory footprint, low latency, and streamlined development process for application engineers.
  • Champion the best practices for coding patterns, API design, scalability, robustness, and optimization. Foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvements among fellow engineers.
  • Provide comprehensive insights and visibility into the performance of our conversational AI product. This involves implementing a robust logging and tracing framework, user-friendly debugging and triaging tools, and automated metrics for efficient monitoring and analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with ML engineers, application engineers, product teams, and customer support teams to drive the development of new features and scalability initiatives.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • A strong foundation in computer science and software engineering, coupled with expertise in building scalable systems.
  • A deep understanding of clean, modular, and scalable API design. You have the ability to champion best coding practices and influence fellow engineers to uphold high standards of code quality and craftsmanship.
  • A passion for optimizing systems and improving performance. You are well-versed in tracing, logging, and metrics frameworks, and possess a systematic approach to quickly identify and resolve latency bottlenecks, race conditions, and throughput limitations.
  • The ability to independently research new requirements and develop innovative solutions. You thrive in an environment of fast-paced coding and execution, embracing rapid iterations to deliver results.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively articulate rationales and design approaches. You have a cross-functional awareness that enables you to collaborate seamlessly with various teams.
  • A bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a related field, demonstrating your academic foundation in the field.

title: Staff Software Engineer_Voice Connectivity
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Overview

The Staff Software Engineer, Voice Connectivity Engineering designs, builds, ships, and operates the connectivity layer between a customer's existing telephony and CCaaS environment and the ServiceNow Voice ecosystem. The engineer works across the full lifecycle: mapping a customer's SIP trunks, CTI integrations, and CCaaS-specific APIs, building and hardening the signaling, media, and event integrations that connect those systems to ServiceNow's Voice/CTI and Native Voice Controls platform, and proving through testing and production monitoring that calls connect, stay connected, and hand off cleanly under real network and carrier conditions. This is not an agent-building role — the engineer is not primarily authoring the prompts or instructions that drive voice AI agent behavior — but it is the foundation those agents run on: without a reliable connectivity layer, no agent, however well designed, can reach a live caller.

Two things follow. First, correctness here is measured in call setup success, audio quality, latency, and failover behavior rather than model output — the engineer's product is a connection that has to hold up under real carrier, network, and vendor conditions, not just in a reference environment. Second, because every customer's telephony and CCaaS setup differs — different SIP providers, media gateways, authentication schemes, and CCaaS vendor quirks — the engineer must design integrations that are resilient and diagnosable, with clear failure signals when a segment of the call path breaks, rather than integrations that only work against the reference stack.

  What You Get to Do

  • Build the connectivity layer. Design, build, and operate the SIP trunking, signaling, and media integrations that connect a customer's telephony and CCaaS platform to ServiceNow's Voice/CTI and Native Voice Controls ecosystem.
  • Integrate with CCaaS and telephony platforms. Implement and harden integrations using the common patterns of SIP trunking and signaling, WebSocket and streaming media APIs, and real-time audio and event interfaces — across CCaaS providers such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Twilio, as well as traditional CTI/PBX and carrier setups.
  • Own call path reliability. Design for call setup success, failover, and graceful degradation across carriers, media gateways, and network conditions; instrument and monitor the connectivity layer for latency, jitter, packet loss, and dropped-call causes.
  • Deliver as a forward deployed engineer, embedded in the customer's environment. Work directly inside a customer's telephony, CTI, and CCaaS environment — mapping their existing architecture, standing up and tuning the connection into ServiceNow's Voice ecosystem, and troubleshooting live issues on their network and vendor stack.
  • Feed the Voice AI agent layer cleanly. Ensure the audio, signaling, and event streams the connectivity layer delivers are clean, well-formed, and low-latency enough for the voice AI agents running on ServiceNow's Voice ecosystem to operate correctly — partnering with agent engineering rather than building the agents yourself.
  • Design for security and compliance on the call path. Implement SIP security, media encryption, authentication, and least-privilege access across the connectivity layer, and account for what regulated or high-security customer environments require.
  • Specify precisely and direct engineering work. Convert customer telephony and CCaaS requirements into testable specifications and integration runbooks with explicit scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into implementable tasks and review the result for correctness and maintainability.
  • Own quality and reliability in production. Monitor connectivity health across live customer deployments, triage call-path incidents, and feed recurring failure patterns back into architecture and runbooks.
  • Collaborate across product, design, and engineering. Partner with product managers, voice AI agent engineers, and platform teams — Voice/CTI, CCaaS, and Native Voice Controls — to define integration requirements, align on tradeoffs, and communicate capability and risk clearly.

Qualifications

To Be Successful in This Role

Experience

A demonstrated track record of building, shipping, and operating production telephony or CCaaS integrations at a Staff Software Engineer level, including hands-on delivery of connectivity between third-party telephony/CCaaS platforms and a hosted or cloud service. Direct, hands-on experience integrating with CCaaS platforms using common patterns — SIP trunking and signaling, WebSocket and streaming media APIs, and real-time audio interfaces — across multiple CCaaS providers, is required. Demonstrated technical leadership is expected at this level: setting architectural direction across teams, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-team integration decisions on voice and telephony systems. Willingness to work directly with customers in a forward deployed capacity, embedded in their telephony and contact center environment, is required; prior forward deployed experience is an advantage. Typically 8+ years of production software experience, with several years focused on telephony, CTI, or real-time communications systems.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus but are not a substitute for a demonstrated record of shipping reliable, production voice and telephony connectivity.

Key Competencies, Skills, and Experience

  • Software engineering fundamentals. Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing.
  • CCaaS and telephony integration patterns. Hands-on experience integrating with CCaaS platforms and telephony infrastructure using SIP trunking and signaling, WebSocket and streaming media APIs, and real-time audio interfaces, across multiple providers such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Twilio, as well as traditional CTI/PBX systems.
  • Real-time communications and media handling. Practical knowledge of SIP, RTP/SRTP, WebRTC, codecs, media gateways, and the latency, jitter, and packet-loss characteristics of live audio.
  • Call path reliability and observability. Ability to design for failover and graceful degradation across carriers and vendors, and to instrument, monitor, and diagnose connectivity issues in production.
  • Voice platform architecture. Working knowledge of how a hosted voice and agent ecosystem — such as ServiceNow's Voice/CTI and Native Voice Controls — consumes audio, signaling, and event streams, enough to design an integration the platform can reliably use without building the agent logic itself.
  • Specification precision and architectural judgment. Ability to define integration and connectivity problems rigorously enough for another engineer to implement correctly, and sound judgment on build-versus-integrate tradeoffs across vendor ecosystems.

title: Senior Staff Applications Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

We are the Industry Vertical Engineering team at ServiceNow. We design and build specialized software solutions tailored to the unique workflows, data models, and regulatory compliance needs of specific sectors, with a particular focus on high-tech and adjacent regulated industries such as telecommunications, healthcare, financial services, and manufacturing, rather than relying on generic, one-size-fits-all solutions. 

We are building the next generation of industry-specific enterprise applications, and increasingly these applications are AI-native: their core behavior is model-driven rather than explicitly authored. They interpret user intent, reason over context, invoke tools, and act on the user's behalf, all while respecting the complex business workflows, specialized data models, and evolving regulatory requirements of the industries we serve. 

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will design, build, ship, and operate AI-native industry applications whose most important logic often lives in natural language (instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, and guardrails) as much as in code. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, and often embedded directly with customers as a forward deployed engineer, building against their data, integrations, and channels. Alongside hands-on delivery, you will drive engineering excellence, mentor other engineers, and influence architecture and long-term platform direction across multiple teams. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Design, build, and deliver scalable, AI-native enterprise applications for industry-specific workflows, data models, and compliance requirements, along with the integrations and channels that make them usable in production. 

  • Build agentic behavior into those applications: intent interpretation, multi-step reasoning, tool and function invocation, and action on the user's behalf, delivered through conversational experiences across chat (and voice where the use case calls for it) that hold context and hand off cleanly between automated and human agents. 

  • Design AI-driven autonomous workflows: decompose business processes into the steps and decision points an agent can execute, decide where autonomy is appropriate and where a human checkpoint is required, and define how exceptions, retries, and hand-back to a person are handled. 

  • Author and maintain agentic instructions (system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation rules) as versioned engineering artifacts under review and regression coverage, not configuration text. 

  • Engineer prompts for reliability rather than demo quality, iterating against measured outcomes: task decomposition, golden examples, structured output schemas, grounding and citation, graceful failure, and token and latency cost. 

  • Build automated evaluation and test non-deterministic behavior: golden datasets, multi-turn conversation suites, model-as-judge scoring calibrated to human review, CI gates, drift detection, and adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool-selection testing. 

  • Design software that lets customers configure and extend platform capabilities without sacrificing performance, reliability, or maintainability, and write clean, reusable, well-tested code following engineering best practices, including code reviews, unit testing, and test automation. 

  • Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents: convert requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, decompose work into agent-sized tasks, and review agent output for correctness and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it. 

  • Deliver as a forward deployed engineer, embedded with customers when the work calls for it: building against their data, integrations, and channels, tuning instructions and evaluation sets in their environment, and returning with evidence that improves the product. 

  • Own quality, safety, and reliability in production: monitor conversation quality, containment, hallucination, and unsafe actions, defend against prompt injection and data leakage, and feed production failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Troubleshoot and optimize performance, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems. 

  • Serve as a technical leader: mentor engineers, promote knowledge sharing, drive engineering best practices, and lead complex technical initiatives spanning multiple teams while influencing architecture and long-term platform direction. 

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions, align on tradeoffs, and communicate capability, limitation, and risk clearly to non-engineers

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience in the SaaS industry, building and operating products at production scale. 
  • A demonstrated track record of building, shipping, and operating production software, including hands-on delivery of AI-native application features that real users depend on rather than demos. 
  • Direct, hands-on experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing AI-driven autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation and testing that verifies non-deterministic behavior. 
  • Advanced command of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, system design, APIs, and performance optimization. 
  • Strong grounding in modern application architecture across cloud, distributed systems, and service-oriented or platform technologies, with solid data modeling and storage fundamentals. Depth matters more than any specific language or framework. 
  • AI-native application development: agent orchestration at the application layer, tool and function calling, context assembly, grounding against enterprise data, and handling latency, cost, and failure. 
  • Prompt engineering and evaluation of non-deterministic systems: intent-driven prompt design plus measurable frameworks for response quality, agent behavior, tool-selection accuracy, and regression risk, iterating against evaluation results rather than impressions. 
  • Specification precision and architectural judgment: the ability to define problems rigorously enough that another engineer or an AI agent implements them correctly, and to decide soundly when to solve a problem in code, in instructions, or by delegating to an agent. 
  • Working knowledge of safety, security, and data handling for AI-integrated applications: prompt injection, sensitive-data and secret leakage, over-broad tool access, and unsafe autonomous action, translated into concrete guardrails, least-privilege controls, and monitoring. 
  • Willingness to work directly with customers in a forward deployed capacity, with the judgment to know when a fast local solution is right and when to hold out for the durable one, and the credibility to communicate capability, limitation, and risk to non-engineers. 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technically complex projects across multiple teams as a technical owner or engineering leader, with strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. 
  • Experience integrating AI into engineering workflows, decision-making, automation, or the software development process itself. 
  • Preferred qualifications: 
  • ServiceNow platform experience is recommended, including building configurable, extensible applications on the platform. 
  • Deep domain experience in high-tech, and familiarity with adjacent regulated industries such as telecommunications, healthcare, financial services, or manufacturing, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. 
  • Experience delivering conversational experiences in chat, voice, or both, including turn and context management, disambiguation and confirmation patterns, and automated-to-human handoff. 
  • Prior forward deployed, solution engineering, or professional services experience delivering software inside a customer's environment. 
  • Familiarity with modern UI frameworks (for example React, Angular, or Vue) and with evaluation, tracing, and prompt or instruction management tooling for LLM applications. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 10+ years of experience with Java or a similar OO language
  • Passion for JavaScript and the Web as a platform, reusability, and componentization
  • Advanced knowledge with data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations
  • Experience with any of the modern UI frameworks like Angular, React or Vue
  • Advanced knowledge experience working with relational databases including development, troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Experience with multiple technology stacks: Cloud Dev, Platforms, Web Dev, Frameworks or service–oriented architecture
  • Capability to manage multiple projects with material technical risk across teams and processes; may serve as a functional lead or technical owner

title: Director, Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Who We're Looking For:

We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead a team of PMs as well as own the product strategy for empowering developers on the Now platform to build and take their applications to production faster. These areas include developer reach, testing, sandboxing, metering, and deployment of AI and human generated code. 

As agentic build tools compress the time it takes to author a change, the bottleneck moves downstream. Testing and deploying safely to production is already one of the loudest customer asks and one of the sharpest pain points on the platform. When changes originate from agents as well as people, and arrive at a much higher rate, the ability to validate and trust them quickly stops being a quality-of-life improvement and becomes a precondition for platform growth. You will lead the team that enables this for developers. 

This is not four adjacent feature areas with a shared manager. Customers experience the SDLC as one motion, and the central product challenge of this role is the connective tissue: a sandbox that behaves like the instance you will deploy to, a test suite that knows what changed, a release path that carries the evidence, and a model for building directly in production that an admin can actually govern. You set the strategy that makes their roadmaps resolve into a single lifecycle rather than four products that ship past each other. 

The scope is deeply technical and close to execution. The Developer Reach feature area alone unlocks a path to building in production that admins can manage at scale without losing control, and it demands real technical depth to steer. You will also carry a broad surface, over twenty product areas, with the escalation volume that comes with it, and you will need to run that operational load without letting it consume the strategic work. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap across Developer Reach, Developer Sandboxes, Agentic Testing, and Release Ops, and define how they compose into one lifecycle from authored change to governed, audited deployment. 

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of PMs, one per area. Set a clear standard for product craft, coach PMs on strategy and execution, and hold the bar on the seams between them: shared primitives, consistent models, and a single coherent customer narrative. 

  • Set product direction for validating AI-originated change at scale: what it means to trust an agent's output, what evidence a release needs to carry, and how much of the test and review burden can be automated without losing accountability. 

  • Drive the Developer Reach strategy, including the product model for building in production with admin control, guardrails, and reversibility at enterprise scale. 

  • Define the sandbox strategy: provisioning speed, production parity, data handling, and the developer experience of getting a safe place to work in seconds rather than days. 

  • Own the release governance path end to end, including the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, and the gating model that makes those tradeoffs explicit rather than accidental. 

  • Shape the metering and cost-modeling strategy for this area in partnership with Pricing & Packaging and Finance, and understand how it impacts the entire App Engine portfolio. 

  • Build the triage discipline that keeps escalations across a broad product surface from displacing the roadmap. 

  • Model an AI-first way of working: use agentic coding tools directly, build and deploy against your own products, and bring firsthand experience of the pain your customers are describing. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 

  • 12+ years of product management experience, including experience leading and growing a team of PMs, with a track record of setting technical strategy independently rather than executing a roadmap someone else defined. 

  • A track record of developing PMs, raising the bar on product thinking and execution across a team, and growing earlier-career PMs into strong owners of their areas. 

  • Deep experience owning developer platform, DevOps, or SDLC products at enterprise scale: CI/CD, test automation, environment management, release orchestration, or change management. 

  • Genuine hands-on technical comfort, including reading code, reasoning about system architecture, and holding your own in design discussions with senior engineers. Direct, regular personal use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf in your own workflow. 

  • Experience with enterprise change-management or release-governance systems and the tradeoffs between developer velocity and auditability, ideally including systems that gate deployment through a controlled artifact such as a change set. 

  • Ideally, experience with test strategy at scale: automated test generation, coverage and flakiness economics, regression management, and what it takes for a team to actually trust a green build. 

  • Familiarity with environment and infrastructure provisioning models, ephemeral environments, production parity, and data seeding or masking, and the cost and security tradeoffs each carries. 

  • Working knowledge of agentic development workflows and what changes when a meaningful share of commits originate from an agent rather than a person: review, attribution, validation, and rollback. 

  • Proven ability to build and defend an executive-level strategic case, and to navigate cross-business-unit governance and ownership disputes at the VP and SVP level, driving alignment across genuinely contested boundaries. 

  • Demonstrated ability to run a high-volume operational surface, triaging escalations and production issues across many product areas while continuing to ship against a multi-year strategy. 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to translate deep technical tradeoffs into a strategy that lands with engineers and with executive stakeholders in the same conversation. 

Why join us? 

  • Own the part of the platform that decides whether agentic development is safe enough for enterprises to adopt, at the moment that question is being answered. 

  • Take four high-stakes bets that are currently separate and make them feel like one product, with the mandate and the team to actually do it. 

  • Drive the Developer Reach strategy for bringing agentic development on the Now platform to any developer in an organization, and the broader production-build model, one of the most technically ambitious efforts in the org and a direct answer to a long-standing customer ask. 

  • Operate at the center of the Platform Agentic Build Lifecycle org during the shift to AI-native software development, with influence over how changes get tested, governed, and released rather than only how they get written. 

  • Grow a team of PMs at the point where the platform’s velocity ceiling is actually set.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

The Role

Are you a software engineer who has honed your craft, partnership, and execution over years building and improving production systems, and are looking to apply your skills at the cutting edge of AI agents? This may be the role for you.

As a senior staff software engineer on our Agentic AI Harness & Quality team, you will play an important part in our mission: to advance the frontier of work that can be entrusted to agents to perform reliably at scale. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Moveworks AI Assistant platform in several of the following areas: agent orchestration, sandboxed file systems and code execution, latency optimization, agent memory, LLM self-reflection and improvement, execution environment simulation, enterprise knowledge graphs, and multimodal I/O.

You will have all the tools of modern enterprise AI at your disposal, including best-in-class LLMs from providers like OpenAI. Our team indexes on moving fast on scalable infrastructure, solving challenging product and engineering problems, and pushing the envelope of value provided to customers. If you are looking to do impactful work with a bright, dedicated, and impact-driven team alongside you, we’d love to have a conversation.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Take on exciting and difficult engineering challenges (see areas listed above) to build and evolve capable AI agent systems that are reliable in every sense of the word
  • Implement frontier AI algorithms and architectures and help productionize them at scale
  • Use the latest advances in machine learning, LLMs, and AI agents to enhance our products and create delightful user experiences
  • Contribute to roadmap and help drive the evolution of engineering areas of growing scope and impact to create lasting value for all our customers
  • Hone your craft in writing robust, extensible, readable, and performant code
  • Partner with subject matter experts across the company including in machine learning, security, product, user experience, and customer success, to learn from each other and build the best enterprise AI product the world has ever seen
  • Mentor other engineers on the team in how to build, maintain, and evolve great software
  • Collaborate with machine learning engineers, learn from each other, and build world-class AI systems

Qualifications

  • 10+ years experience designing, building, and improving production systems, ideally at scale

They are responsible for team performance, career development, hiring, and execution of key business initiatives. This role requires the ability to balance people development with business results, think strategically about AI integration and platform architecture, and influence across the organization to enable team success. The ideal candidate brings experience scaling AI-native teams and a passion for building leaders.

  • Participate in employer branding and represent the organization at recruiting events and universities

Responsibility Area: Technical Strategy & Product Leadership

  • Establish technical direction for the team; make architecture and technology decisions that balance innovation, quality, and delivery
  • Ensure the team's technical approach stays current with AI/ML advancements and ServiceNow platform evolution
  • Champion AI-native thinking across the team and organization; help teammates understand how to build with AI at the core
  • Lead architectural reviews and technical decision-making; provide guidance on complex technical trade-offs
  • Advocate for technical investments (refactoring, infrastructure, tooling) that improve team productivity and code quality
  • Set quality standards for code, testing, and security; establish practices that enable sustainable delivery
  • Partner with IC4/IC5 engineers to set multi-year technical roadmaps and long-term strategic initiatives
  • Represent the engineering team in product and executive discussions; influence organizational priorities

Responsibility Area: Team Execution & Accountability

  • Drive team delivery of committed business objectives and product initiatives; maintain accountability for results
  • Establish clear sprint goals, work-item prioritization, and delivery timelines; remove blockers for team success
  • Track team metrics: velocity, quality, customer satisfaction, incident response, deployment frequency
  • Conduct regular retrospectives; identify process improvements and drive adoption of better practices
  • Manage team capacity; balance new feature development, technical debt reduction, and customer support
  • Ensure team participation in on-call rotation; monitor incident response and post-incident learning
  • Report on team progress, risks, and performance to senior leadership; provide transparent communication
  • Escalate critical issues or resource constraints; collaborate with peer managers to solve cross-team dependencies
  • Foster a culture of ownership where engineers take responsibility for quality, testing, and production outcomes
  • Lead team through organizational changes and initiatives; maintain morale and focus during transitions

Responsibility Area: Customer & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers and stakeholders; understand their needs and priorities
  • Participate in customer meetings, technical escalations, and business reviews; represent engineering capabilities and constraints
  • Work closely with product management, customer success, and other teams; ensure alignment on priorities and capabilities
  • Lead customer-critical incident response; ensure timely and professional resolution of critical issues
  • Gather customer feedback and translate into product improvements; communicate back to customers how feedback is addressed
  • Advocate for customers' needs within the engineering organization; ensure customer voice is heard in decision-making
  • Build trust and credibility with customers through transparency, responsiveness, and technical leadership
  • Participate in strategic customer discussions and technology roadmap reviews

Responsibility Area: Organizational Leadership & Culture

  • Model the organization's values and desired behaviors; set tone for engineering culture within your team and across teams
  • Contribute to hiring and interview training of other managers; build bench strength in people leadership
  • Mentor junior managers or peers; contribute to manager development and leadership pipeline
  • Participate in engineering leadership meetings; contribute to organizational strategy and policy
  • Promote psychological safety, inclusion, and belonging; actively work to reduce barriers for underrepresented groups
  • Foster knowledge sharing across the organization; encourage your team to contribute to brown bags, documentation, and communities
  • Lead by example in work-life balance, continuous learning, and sustainable pace; prevent burnout
  • Encourage your team to engage with the broader tech community (conferences, open source, speaking, writing)

Responsibility Area: AI-Native Thinking & Innovation Leadership

  • Develop deep understanding of AI/ML capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns; become a thought leader on AI-native development
  • Coach your team on AI-native thinking—how to build systems with AI at the core, not as an afterthought
  • Help engineers understand prompt engineering, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and responsible AI principles
  • Establish practices for evaluation-driven development, hallucination detection, and model performance monitoring
  • Lead discussions on AI safety, data privacy, and responsible AI; ensure team builds with appropriate guardrails
  • Create learning opportunities for the team to stay current with AI/ML advancements and frameworks
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve internal processes and team efficiency
  • Contribute to organizational conversations about AI strategy and responsible AI practices
  • Stay informed about LLM advancements, new models, and emerging techniques; share insights with your team

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of professional software development experience, with 5+ years in AI-native systems, cloud-native architecture, or equivalent
  • 5+ years of people management experience leading software engineers; track record of developing talent and building high-performing teams
  • 3+ years managing application development on SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar); deep understanding of platform architecture and constraints
  • 3+ years hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices
  • Demonstrated expertise in hiring, team building, and organizational development; ability to attract and develop top talent
  • Expert-level understanding of modern software engineering practices: CI/CD, testing, security, deployment
  • Strong technical credibility; ability to engage in technical discussions with IC4/IC5 engineers; hands-on coding experience still valued
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript; understanding of ServiceNow scripting and platform APIs
  • Track record of delivering significant business results through engineering teams; ability to drive accountability and execution
  • Experience scaling teams and organizations; demonstrated ability to work at multiple levels of complexity
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills; ability to develop engineers across all career stages
  • Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies; ability to adapt to team and organizational needs
  • Demonstrated understanding of data security, compliance, and responsible AI practices
  • Strong emotional intelligence; ability to navigate difficult conversations and build trust
  • Experience with performance management, feedback delivery, and difficult personnel decisions
  • Passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams where all engineers can thrive

You will provide a proactive, strategic perspective, manage customer relationships, and drive tactical execution from initial conception through FDE build development, delivery, and successful completion.   

Who You Are: 

You are a dynamic and innovative problem-solver who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a strong analytical mindset while still keeping focus on the bigger picture. You have a background managing SDLC processes while keeping a customer-first mentality. You have a passion for AI and scaling innovation. You excel at transforming ambiguity into clarity and have hands on experience driving projects/programs end to end.  

What You’ll Do: 

  • Work seamlessly with software engineers, product managers, product designers, and customers, to deliver intelligent systems that address mission-critical challenges using AI. 
  • Collaborate directly with customers to co-innovate AI solutions tailored to their needs, acting as the first point of contact or escalation. 
  • Develop trusted relationships with key internal and external technology leaders and stakeholders to drive focus on the strategic build objectives and optimize build delivery - this includes supporting and holding resources accountable for their responsibilities within the build.  
  • Drive large scale, cross-functional, high visibility AI software development builds on condensed timelines.   
  • Organize complex, ambiguous problems into prioritized milestones, deliverables, and success criteria for your builds, translating business objectives into execution strategy (tactical and strategic).  
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent builds from delivering on objectives, especially on the AI/ML deployment front. 
  • Help manage risks, dependencies and escalate impediments, as well as releases and navigating AI release requirements.  
  • Drive process improvements and create documentation to promote best practices using automation to replace repeatable, operational tasks.   
  • Coordinate day to day activities required to deliver a great solution on time, as well as create transparency through reports, dashboards, and status updates. 
  • Seek to continuously grow by proactively seeking and embracing constructive feedback, as well as provide feedback to colleagues to encourage an open and collaborative culture . 

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of project/program management experience in mid/large size software development companies. 
  • A solid understanding of SDLC and release management practices in cloud-based SaaS product organizations.  
  • Prior work delivering AI or intelligent workflow solutions at scale, with proven success in deploying AI solutions that delivered tangible customer impact. 
  • Familiarity with AI governance, compliance, and enterprise security practices 
  • This role includes occasional travel.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Demonstrated competence in key AI/ML software engineering program management best practices: program planning, schedule construction and management; risk assessment & mitigation, dependency management, change management, and predictive metrics.  
  • Outstanding collaboration and communication skills - clearly communicate changes, requests, and deadlines to the teams and risks, status, progress, and decisions to a variety of audiences including executives. 
  • Passion for working with people in technical and innovative environments, with the ability to work well with many different types of personalities in various functions.     
  • Strong leadership and relationship building skills to influence and motivate without authority - masterful in the art of bringing people together.  
  • Strong facilitation skills to lead/drive a variety of build events, with a high regard for quality, drive for continuous improvement across the organization, and ability to keep the big picture in view. 
  • Experience deploying AI solutions to production and skilled at identifying waste/delays in AI end-to-end development, deployment, and release processes.

Job Description

ServiceNow is looking for a Senior Manager, Partner Led Channel & Growth Operations to wear three critical hats across AMS GPC: incubating Partner Led Channel as a new business model in AMS, supporting Canada operations as a business partner, and enabling Major Area Strategists to drive pipeline growth and partner presence in AMS Major Areas. This is a high-impact, multi-dimensional role that sits at the intersection of new business model enablement, operational excellence, and strategic growth support. You'll work with Global Operations, a new PLC leader, regional operations, and strategists to make this portfolio execute.

What You'll Own

Partner Led Channel Incubation & Enablement (40%)

  • Global Ops alignment: Partner with Global Operations to understand PLC operating model, business requirements, and operational structure. Translate Global model to AMS context.
  • Systems & process definition: Understand how PLC operates within our backend systems, define data flows, deal routing, partner hierarchy, and operational workflows that enable the model.
  • New leader enablement: Work with new PLC leader to understand their business priorities, operational needs, and scaling plans. Help them navigate AMS operational infrastructure and best practices.
  • Operational roadmap: Support the PLC launch/ramp plan for AMS—what systems get configured when, what processes need to be in place, staffing/capacity planning. Work with leader to execute roadmap and enable team.
  • Cross-org coordination: Coordinate with Data & Systems team, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure PLC can operate smoothly within AMS infrastructure.

Canada Sales Operations & Execution (30%)

  • Forecasting discipline: Manage weekly/monthly forecast submission, validation, and accuracy. Own forecast quality and integrity.
  • Deal review coaching: Support deal reviews with Canada leader and team. Diagnose deal health, identify risks, surface pull-in candidates.
  • Pipeline intelligence: Track pipeline composition, stage velocity, sourced vs. sell-through. Surface early-warning signals on stalled deals.
  • Performance management: Coordinate quarterly/annual performance management—MBO setting, attainment tracking, individual conversations.
  • Operational discipline: Ensure agreed-upon sales processes are followed. Escalate issues to Partner Operations team.

Database Provisioning builds the tools that safely operate and manage the databases running in ServiceNow data centers, including RaptorDB, ServiceNow's PostgreSQL-based database. Internal operations and support teams use the CLI tools we create, and so does every automation running in a ServiceNow data center. Our challenge is to deliver high-quality solutions that run reliably, without interruption, at massive scale. Our work is fundamental to ServiceNow's reliability, reputation, and success. 

We believe ease of use, quality, scale, and customer feedback are the pillars of good development. We work in a very collaborative environment with distributed teams in the US and Europe. New team members are mentored in the skills they need to become strong contributors. 

What you get to do in this role 

  • Build and improve snc-provision, our in-house framework that deploys, configures and operates RaptorDB (PostgreSQL) and MariaDB databases in production, including the snow CLI used by operations teams and automation, and Dojo, our fleet-wide scheduled maintenance and monitoring service. 
  • Own well-scoped features from design through implementation, test automation and delivery, with guidance from senior engineers. 
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, and take part in code and design reviews. 
  • Automate operational tasks across a large database fleet, from configuration management to monitoring and remediation. 
  • Help investigate production issues, including database crashes, backup/restore failures and performance problems, and learn to drive root-cause analysis from logs, stack traces, and system data. 
  • Work with operations, support, and partner engineering teams to understand requirements and turn feedback into improvements. 
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks, and share what you learn with the team. 

To be successful in this role you have 

  • A solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. 
  • Hands-on experience with Linux, and an interest in learning its internals. 
  • Familiarity with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, MySQL or MariaDB, and a desire to learn how they run in production. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity about how systems fail.

title: Staff Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tout a commencé sous le soleil de San Diego, en Californie, en 2004, lorsqu’un ingénieur visionnaire, Fred Luddy, a vu le potentiel de transformer notre façon de travailler. Aujourd’hui, ServiceNow se présente comme un leader mondial du marché, apportant une technologie innovante améliorée par l’IA à plus de 8 100 clients, dont 85% des entreprises du Fortune 500®. Notre plateforme intelligente basée sur le nuage connecte de manière transparente les personnes, les systèmes et les processus pour permettre aux organisations de trouver des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, plus rapides et meilleures. Mais ce n’est que le début de notre voyage. Joignez-vous à nous dans la poursuite de notre objectif de rendre le monde meilleur pour tous.

######

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Description de poste

En tant que chercheur principal, vous travaillerez sur des questions de recherche auxquelles la plupart des laboratoires d’IA n’ont tout simplement pas accès. La recherche en IA de ServiceNow a pour mission de bâtir l’avenir de l’IA agentique en entreprise, avec un point de vue privilégié : nous observons le comportement réel des agents, au sein d’environnements d’entreprise complexes et à grande échelle.

Vous contribuerez à des initiatives de recherche portant sur la manière dont les agents accumulent et réutilisent les connaissances tacites, sur leur capacité d’apprentissage et d’amélioration continue, ainsi que sur leur résilience, leur sécurité et la confidentialité des données qu’ils traitent. Ce sont les véritables obstacles au déploiement de l’IA agentique en entreprise aujourd’hui, et ils apparaissent dans la réalité opérationnelle bien avant d’être documentés dans la littérature scientifique.

Alors que la majeure partie de la communauté IA et TAL se concentre sur les capacités fondamentales des agents, notre équipe explore les dimensions qui déterminent l’adoption réelle : mécanismes de sécurité, détection des menaces, garanties de confidentialité et pratiques d’IA responsable. Vous aurez la liberté de publier et de faire progresser l’état de l’art, avec l’avantage rare de tester vos hypothèses sur de véritables déploiements plutôt que sur des bancs d’essai.

#######

As a Staff Researcher, you will work on research questions that most AI labs simply do not have access to. ServiceNow AI Research is chartered to build the future of enterprise agentic AI, from a rare vantage point: we see how agents actually behave, inside complex enterprise environments, at scale. 

You will contribute to research initiatives on how agents accumulate and reuse tacit knowledge, learn and improve continuously, and on their resilience, their safety, and the privacy of the data they handle. These are the real obstacles to enterprise agentic deployment today, and they surface in operational reality well before they appear in the literature. 

While much of the AI and NLP community concentrates on core agent capabilities, our team explores the dimensions that determine real adoption: safety mechanisms, threat detection, privacy guarantees, and responsible AI practices. You will have the freedom to publish and advance the state of the art, with the rare advantage of testing your hypotheses against real deployments rather than against benchmarks. 

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Doctorat en informatique, en apprentissage automatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience de recherche équivalente
  • Au moins deux ans d’expérience de recherche après le doctorat, dont une part importante en milieu industriel ou au contact direct de systèmes déployés
  • Historique de publications dans des conférences de premier plan (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP ou équivalents), avec des contributions reconnues comme influentes dans votre domaine
  • Expérience avérée de définition et d’exécution d’un programme de recherche, et pas seulement d’exécution : vous avez choisi des problèmes avant que la communauté ne s’y intéresse, et vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi
  • Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes ou de projets interdisciplinaires, en collaboration avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs
  • Solides compétences en développement logiciel : vous écrivez, maintenez et optimisez du code de recherche de haute qualité, et vous savez ce qu’il faut pour qu’un résultat survive le passage en production
  • Utilisation avancée des outils agentiques dans votre propre pratique de recherche, et volonté de faire progresser les pratiques de l’équipe dans ce domaine
  • Capacité démontrée d’influencer des décisions techniques au-delà de votre propre équipe, notamment auprès des équipes produit et ingénierie
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des travaux techniques complexes à des publics non spécialisés et à des dirigeants

Atouts

  • Expertise dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : mémoire des agents et connaissances tacites, apprentissage continu, sécurité et alignement, sécurité informatique et détection des menaces, confidentialité, évaluation des agents
  • Expérience de systèmes d’IA opérant dans de véritables environnements d’entreprise, avec les contraintes de conformité, de gouvernance et d’échelle que cela implique
  • Contributions à des logiciels libres, jeux de données ou bancs d’essai d’évaluation utilisés par la communauté
  • Rôles de service scientifique : comités de programme, travail éditorial, organisation d’ateliers
  • Collaborations académiques ou encadrement de doctorants
  • Maîtrise du français, ou intérêt à l’apprendre, dans un environnement de travail bilingue à Montréal

Requirements 

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience 
  • 2 or more years of research experience post-PhD, a significant portion of it in an industrial setting or in direct contact with deployed systems 
  • Established publication record at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or equivalents), with contributions recognized as influential in your field 
  • Demonstrated track record of setting/executing research agenda, not only executing one: you have chosen problems before the community turned to them, and you can explain why 
  • Experience working on cross-disciplinary teams or projects collaborating with researchers and engineers 
  • Strong software development skills: you write, maintain, and optimize high-quality research code, and you know what it takes for a result to survive the move into production 
  • Advanced use of agentic tools in your own research practice, and a willingness to advance the team's practices in this area 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions beyond your own team, particularly with product and engineering teams 
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical work to non-specialist audiences and to executives 

Nice to have 

  • Expertise in one or more of the following areas: agent memory and tacit knowledge, continual learning, safety and alignment, security and threat detection, privacy, agent evaluation 
  • Experience with AI systems operating in real enterprise environments, with the compliance, governance, and scale constraints that entails 
  • Contributions to open source software, datasets, or evaluation benchmarks used by the community 
  • Scientific service roles: program committees, editorial work, workshop organization 
  • Academic collaborations or supervision of doctoral students 
  • Fluency in French, or interest in learning it, in a bilingual Montreal work environment
