descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This is not an ML role. This is a distributed systems engineering role at the heart of the agentic AI wave.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.


What you get to do in this role:

  • Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
  • Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using DynamoDB conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
  • Event-driven message pipeline — SQS FIFO queues for ordered delivery, Kafka consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
  • Structured concurrency — Python asyncio TaskGroups running multiple concurrent tasks per session (message polling, lease heartbeats, output publishing, orchestrator execution) with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
  • Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
  • Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

  • Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
  • Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
  • Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
  • Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
  • gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

Required:

  • 10+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
  • Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
  • Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
  • Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a Senior Manager, Partner Technology Architecture to lead a team of
Partner Technology Architects serving our Global and strategic partners. As a first-line people
leader, you will build and develop a high-performing team that drives holistic partner growth
through pre-sales technical excellence, solution strategy, business development, and AI-first
technology adoption. You will remain hands-on: coaching your team, staying close to critical
partner engagements, and owning the outcomes your team delivers. You will translate platform
capabilities, AI innovation, and industry context into repeatable, outcome-driven offerings that
partners can build, scale, and monetize. This role requires travel for partner, customer, and
organizational activities of up to 30%.
While this role leads strategic business development and co-innovation, pre-sales technical
excellence remains the primary operational foundation for the team, including technical
discovery, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept leadership, and architectural validation that
accelerates partner-led customer engagements.


What You’ll Do
As a Senior Manager, you will lead a team of Partner Technology Architects, set their priorities
against partner and Global Partners & Alliances goals, and remain accountable for the partner
outcomes your team delivers.
People Leadership & Team Development
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Partner Technology Architects, setting clear goals
and growing each member according to business needs and individual professional
goals.
• Evaluate team members regularly through direct observation, peer feedback, and sales
feedback.
• Build and maintain a recruiting pipeline and hire to meet future business demands.
• Manage day-to-day team operations, including resource scheduling, activity reporting,
and expense review and approval.
• Assign resources to partner engagements, joint solution development, and demand

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

ServiceNow seeks a staff-level product security engineer to serve as a senior technical authority within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT). PSIRT is ServiceNow's awareness, response, and investigation capability for post-release vulnerabilities in ServiceNow-developed products and service offerings. 

This role is for a recognized expert who can operate independently and as part of a team on the most significant security issues facing the platform—vulnerabilities that require evaluating intangibles. You will lead deep-dive investigations, coordinate resolution across engineering, product, and release teams, and demonstrate calm, decisive leadership during significant security events. 

This is a role for someone who already understands product development cycles and the engineering and product relationships that drive them—and will use that fluency to lead fixes to completion under incident pressure. You will help shape how ServiceNow responds to product security vulnerabilities at scale and the technical rigor of the entire response capability. 

The coverage provided by this role is: 

  • Sunday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST. 

  • Monday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST. 

  • Tuesday: 02:00 - 10:00 UTC / 07:30 to 15:30 IST. 

  • Friday: 06:00 - 13:00 UTC / 11:30 - 18:30 IST. 

  • Saturday: 03:00 - 12:00 UTC / 08:30 - 17:30 IST. 

Due to the nature of incident response and needs of the business, coverage may change. Additional coverage outside of stated hours may be required in response to significant incidents.  

What you get to do in this role:

         Lead Through Significant Security Events

  • Demonstrate technical and organizational leadership during these events—bringing structure and clear decision-making under pressure. 
  • Partner with incident commanders, business information security leadership, engineering, and customer-facing teams to maintain clear ownership, workstream prioritization, and hand-offs during these events. 

         Reduce Exposure Window 

  • Drive coordinated response across affected releases, balancing risk and remediation feasibility. 
  • Leverage an understanding of product development cycles and engineering/product partnerships to move fixes through the release pipeline without stalling on organizational boundaries. 
  • Verify fix completeness and guard against incomplete mitigations before release. 


         CVE & Coordinated Disclosure Process 

  • Contributed to ServiceNow's CVE disclosure process for incidents you own—CVE assignment, scoring, advisory content, and publication timing. 
  • Conduct technical accuracy reviews of external advisories, researcher write-ups, and joint disclosure content to ensure correctness before publication. 

      Pursue After-Action Outcomes & Continuous Improvement 
     
  • Author root cause analyses and drive lessons learned to closure following product security incidents. 
  • Participate in retrospectives following significant product security events, translating findings into concrete process and technical improvements. 
  • Contribute to partner teams tracking product security risk themes and trends across the portfolio. 
    Contribute to SDLC improvement areas, feeding incident learnings upstream into secure development practices. 

Qualifications

 To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

  • Minimum 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience; or equivalent experience. 

  • Minimum 4 years of auditing source code for security vulnerabilities. 

  • Demonstrated leadership during significant security events or major incidents, with willingness to participate in on-call. 

  • Ability to read and comprehend Java and JavaScript code.  

  • Strong understanding of common Java and JavaScript vulnerabilities.  

  • Proficiency in scripting in both Python and JavaScript for data gathering, processing, and visualization.  

  • Development of proof-of-concept exploits for web application vulnerabilities.  

  • Written and verbal communication of complex security risk clearly to both technical teams and leadership. 

  • Experience with leading fix implementation and release coordination across engineering, product, and test/release teams. 

  • Proficiency in deep-dive product security investigations and root-cause analysis spanning design, code, configuration, and operational layers. 

  • Exploit analysis and proof-of-concept development that distinguishes real exploitability from theoretical risk. 

  • Familiarity with SDLC integration, CI/CD pipelines, SaaS threat models, and secure development practices. 

    Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a PSIRT or similar function for a major software or SaaS platform. 

  • Recognized expertise in product security incident response, vulnerability research, or application security within a software or SaaS environment. 

  • Experience conducting vulnerability assessments on the ServiceNow platform. 

  • Experience with emerging threats: AI-specific attack vectors, software supply chain security, and SDLC tooling security. 

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments. 

  • Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSWE) or demonstrated equivalent expertise.

You will work directly with customer engineering teams to implement, configure, and optimize our Application Security (AppSec) solutions. Your mission is simple: make customers successful, remove friction, and ensure the product delivers real value in production.

What You’ll Do

Customer Deployment & Enablement

  • Lead hands-on deployment, configuration, and integration of AppSec solutions in customer environments

  • Work directly with developers, engineering managers, and security teams to operationalize the platform

  • Ensure customers move from initial setup to advanced use cases quickly

Field Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Act as the front line for technical problem-solving in real-world environments

  • Debug issues across infrastructure, APIs, and application layers

  • Identify product gaps and, when needed, fix bugs or contribute code alongside engineering

Customer Success & Adoption

  • Drive successful outcomes across multiple customers simultaneously

  • Keep high-value customers engaged, productive, and expanding usage

  • Partner closely with Customer Success on POVs, onboarding, and adoption strategies

Product Feedback & Improvement

  • Gather real-world usage insights and translate them into actionable product feedback

  • Collaborate with engineering to improve usability, performance, and scalability

  • Help make the product easier to deploy, configure, and operate

Qualifications

  • Strong experience with Application Security (AppSec) concepts (SAST, DAST, APIs, vulnerabilities)

  • Hands-on experience with APIs, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), and modern architectures

Great production makes ambitious ideas possible. We’re looking for an Executive Producer who brings creative ingenuity, production expertise, and a drive to explore what’s next.

As part of ServiceNow’s Brand Strategy & Creative team, you’ll lead integrated content production across digital, social, video, events, and stills. You’ll partner with creative leaders from the earliest conversations, assemble the right talent and partners, and guide work from first idea to final delivery.

You’ll also help shape the future of production at ServiceNow, combining exceptional craft with generative AI, emerging tools, and smarter ways of working. This is an opportunity to make distinctive work for a global technology brand while building the capabilities to keep raising our ambition.

What you’ll do

  • Bring ambitious ideas to life. Lead production of video, social content, digital assets, event content, animation, and photography.

Qualifications

 To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

  • Experience designing solutions for at least one priority industry(FSI, Telco, Public sector), with a track record of reusable industry patterns or accelerators
  • Background in pre-sales or technical roles, including pursuit support, technical validation, and proof-of-value delivery
  • Certifications such as ServiceNow Certified Application Developer, Certified System Administrator, or Certified Implementation Specialist, where applicable, plus relevant cloud or integration credentials
  • Experience working across Asia markets, with the ability to engage both regional and local customer teams
  • Deep product expertise across the ServiceNow portfolio, including workflow automation, AI, and platform capabilities
  • Solution design, integration architecture, and API-based integration patterns
  • Industry business process knowledge in one or more priority verticals
  • Technical discovery, solution workshops, and requirements translation

Job Description

ServiceNow CRM helps companies sell, fulfil, and service customers on one AI-powered platform, spanning Customer Service Management, Field Service Management, and Sales CRM.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will design and build features across CSM Playbooks and customer service workflows, including case and work order management and guided agent experiences.

You will own complex components end to end, working closely with product, design, and adjacent platform teams to ship workflows that agents and customers rely on every day. You will bring strong engineering fundamentals, a bias for quality at scale, and a drive to make customer-facing processes faster and more intelligent with AI.

What you will do:

  • Build high-quality, scalable, clean, and reusable applications and integration solutions using ServiceNow platform and related technologies. 
  • Partner with the product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, test automation and delivery of high-quality products to our users. 
  • Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components with a strong emphasis on performance and reliability.   
  • Own critical technical initiatives from planning to deployment, continuously refining and improving existing applications and services. 
  • Explore the latest ServiceNow features and evaluate them for adoption 
  • Develop proof-of-concept and prototype solutions to validate architectural, design decisions and demonstrate feasibility. 
  • Establish and promote best practices around platform development, integrations, and performance optimization. 
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by sharing best practices in engineering and quality  
  • Mentor and guide engineers, fostering technical excellence and professional growth within the team. 

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering, with a record of technical direction adopted beyond your immediate team.  
  • Effective, accountable use of AI coding assistants and agents. 
  • Direct, hands-on experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation that verifies them.  
  • Production experience with LLM APIs, retrieval-grounded features, agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement — including at least one model or orchestration migration carried through production.  
  • Experience in system design, APIs, data modelling, and testing across front-end, server-side, and relational data work with a high quality mindset. 
  • Experience in software stack including Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React and demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools and frameworks.  
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG, Playwright) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
  • On-call and incident-command experience on customer-facing systems, including ownership of the systemic fixes that followed.  
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack. 
  • Bachelor's degree in CS, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.  

Good to have:   

  • Experience using AI Coding tools such as Claude or Codex. 
  • CRM domain knowledge and working experience

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Who we are

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!



ServiceNow

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Security compliance is still mostly manual work: screenshots, spreadsheets, and evidence pulled together by hand in the weeks before an audit. We want to run it the opposite way. This role builds the automation so evidence collection and control monitoring happen continuously, and we could pass an audit in any given month because the system is always current. You will treat compliance as code, and you will care about getting the controls right, not just getting them checked. Your mission will be to replace legacy compliance processes with intelligent, automated platforms that scale effortlessly. We want someone who looks at traditional compliance and thinks, "There has to be a better way." You are an AI-native engineer who knows how and when to apply AI across the entire compliance engineering lifecycle—from writing software and automating evidence collection to validating controls, generating documentation, streamlining audits, and building the next generation of compliance automation.

This is an IC tech lead role. You will be hands on.

You will own the software engineering behind our compliance certifications, leading technical engagements with external auditors for international certifications and regulations such as ISMAP, IRAP, C5, etc. Rather than treating audits as periodic projects, you will build and operate systems that keep our controls continuously validated and our evidence continuously available. Success means audits become a confirmation of how we already operate.

Your vision will color the blueprint of our compliance strategy, propelling Moveworks not just to meet the future but to define it. Ready to make a monumental impact? Join us and transform the essence of compliance at Moveworks.



What you get to do in this role:

  • Build and own automated evidence collection pipelines that integrate with cloud infrastructure, identity providers, source control, ticketing systems, and other security tooling.

  • Design and implement continuous control monitoring, ensuring compliance is measured in real time rather than only during audit periods.

  • Challenge the status quo of compliance. Replace manual, paper-driven processes with software and engineering-first systems. We're looking for builders who believe compliance should be automated, elegant, and designed—not buried in paperwork.

  • Own the technical strategy for future certifications and regulatory frameworks, evaluating new requirements and designing scalable solutions that minimize operational overhead.

  • Use AI where it fits. Apply LLMs and agents to map controls to evidence, validate it, and flag drift.

  • Spearhead international compliance initiatives such as ISMAP, IRAP, C5, etc.

  • Navigate auditor relationships with adept expertise, ensuring smooth and compliant audits.

  • Lead and drive the charge in partnering with key stakeholders to ensure compliance and controls are effectively implemented, and any findings are remediated.

  • Create and transform documentation such as policies, procedures, and other compliance written material.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineer/information security roles, with a specific focus on security compliance and risk management.

  • Fluency in Japanese, including reading, writing, and speaking, is required (ISMAP).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISM, CISSP, CISA) are preferred.

  • A bias to remove manual work. When you see a recurring manual task, your instinct is to automate it away.

  • Demonstrated experience in developing, managing, and implementing security policies and compliance frameworks such as ISMAP, IRAP, C5, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, NIST, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type 2.

  • Knowledge of security principles, controls, and technologies/products.

  • Familiarity with cloud security practices and cloud provider compliance standards (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Expertise with AWS services.

  • Exceptional communication, written, and presentation skills capable of engaging a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Skills in identifying security risks, implementing mitigation strategies, and driving remediation end-to-end.

  • Experience with navigating international and domestic security regulations.

descriptionHtml:

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Role 

You'll own the end-to-end technical relationship with enterprise customers, translating complex business challenges into high-impact AI solutions built on the Moveworks Platform. This is a customer-facing, field-based role — you'll be the primary technical point of contact throughout the full implementation lifecycle, from solution design through launch. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding with a customer's IT team in the morning and collaborating with internal engineering and product teams in the afternoon. 

This is not a back-office engineering role — you will be in front of customers regularly and are expected to travel up to 25% of the time. 

What You'll Own 

  • Customer Technical Relationships: Serve as the primary technical owner across 5–8 enterprise customer engagements simultaneously, driving adoption and measurable outcomes across the full Moveworks implementation lifecycle. 
  • Solution Design & Architecture: Partner with customers to architect and deliver high-impact AI solutions that solve real business challenges — leveraging the Moveworks Platform in innovative and meaningful ways. 
  • Integration & Implementation: Design and build secure, performant integrations between the Moveworks Platform and customer enterprise systems including ServiceNow, Workday, Okta, Jira, and others. 
  • Strategic Advisory: Serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers develop their Agentic AI roadmap and upskilling their teams to operate the platform independently over time. 
  • Product Feedback Loop: Synthesize on-the-ground customer feedback and technical gaps, working directly with Moveworks Engineering and Product teams to influence platform evolution. 
  • Reusability & Knowledge Sharing: Generalize successful customer solutions into reusable templates and share learnings broadly across the team. 

About You 

You are a technical generalist who genuinely enjoys working directly with customers. You thrive at the intersection of engineering, consulting, and customer success — and you're equally energized by solving a complex integration problem and presenting a solution narrative to a customer's executive team. 

  • Customer-First Mindset: You have strong communication and relationship skills, and you're compelled to develop and deliver compelling solution narratives through high-quality artifacts — architecture diagrams, solution proposals, SOWs — tailored to both technical and business audiences. 
  • Technical Mastery: You have a strong grasp of API-based systems integration, LLM-based systems design including prompt engineering, context engineering, and data modeling. 
  • Curiosity & Adaptability: You are a rapid learner with high technical aptitude — equally curious about what's happening under the hood and why a business process works the way it does. 
  • Product Judgment: You have strong product taste and are obsessed with delivering exceptional experiences for end users. 
  • Entrepreneurial Grit: You lean into ambiguity, navigate legacy systems with patience, and actively seek exposure across engineering, product, and business functions.

Job Description

This is a rare chance to lead the technical direction of one of the fastest-growing, most strategic businesses at ServiceNow. CRM & Industry Workflows is where the company is investing to win, and agentic AI is at the center of that bet — reshaping how customers run sales automation, CPQ, customer service, and field service. As Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the lead architect for the FDE group within CRM & Industry Engineering: the person who turns that ambition into working solutions in front of real customers.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You work directly with ServiceNow customers to analyze their business and AI use cases, design agentic solutions on the ServiceNow platform, and deploy them into production. As the most senior technical member of the group, you set the solution architecture and deployment patterns the FDE team reuses across engagements, and you own the correctness, reliability, and business outcomes of the agentic systems the group delivers. Your work compounds: the patterns you establish are adopted across a growing team and a growing customer base, and your influence extends back into the ServiceNow platform itself.

The role rewards proximity to the customer and soundness of judgment over volume of code. Agentic solutions behave probabilistically rather than deterministically, so value concentrates in framing the right use cases, designing solutions that hold up in production, and verifying that autonomous behavior matches customer intent. You will spend more time with customers — in discovery, solutioning, and deployment — than on any other activity, and you will raise the whole group’s ability to do the same. For a senior engineer who wants to shape an emerging discipline, build a team’s technical foundation, and see their impact scale with the business, the growth runway is significant.

What you get in this role:

  • Analyze customer use cases. Work directly with customer business and technical teams to understand their processes, data, and goals across sales automation, CPQ, customer service, and field service, and translate ambiguous problem statements into well-scoped agentic AI use cases with clear success criteria. 
  • Architect the solution. Design agentic AI solutions on the ServiceNow platform — agent workflows, tool and system integrations, data and context design, and guardrails — that fit cleanly into the customer’s existing landscape and deliver measurable outcomes. 
  • Deploy into production. Own the path from design to live deployment: build and configure the solution, integrate with customer systems, validate behavior against intent, and shepherd it through the customer’s environment into production use. 
  • Set the technical strategy and standards for the group. Define the multi-engagement technical direction, reference architectures, reusable deployment patterns, and solution accelerators the FDE team applies across customers, so successful engagements scale rather than being rebuilt each time. 
  • Be the customer’s trusted technical advisor. Serve as the senior engineering voice in customer conversations — from working sessions to executive discussions — clearly communicating what agentic AI can and cannot do, the tradeoffs involved, and how to adopt it responsibly. 
  • Verify quality, reliability, and safety. Confirm that deployed agents are correct, secure, and reliable: validate edge cases and failure modes, guard against risks such as prompt injection and data leakage, and put monitoring and rollback in place for behavioral drift in production. 
  • Lead the FDE group technically. Provide architectural direction, review, and mentorship across the group’s engagements, unblocking the hardest technical problems and raising the overall standard of solutioning and delivery. 
  • Close the loop with product and engineering. Feed field learnings — recurring use cases, gaps, and platform friction — back into ServiceNow product and engineering to improve the platform for CRM & Industry customers at large. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

A demonstrated track record of designing, deploying, and operating production software and AI solutions in customer-facing settings, with clear evidence of leading complex engagements to successful business outcomes. As a Principal Engineer, this person is a recognized technical authority who is highly autonomous: they set the multi-engagement technical strategy and architecture standards the FDE group follows, drive their own agenda in alignment with org goals, navigate organizational ambiguity confidently, and coach senior engineers.

  • Customer-facing solution delivery. Extensive experience working directly with customers to analyze needs, architect solutions, and deploy them to production — in a forward-deployed, professional services, solution architecture, or comparable delivery role.
  • Agentic AI and applied ML. Hands-on experience designing and operating autonomous agent systems — planning, tool invocation, memory, context design, and guardrails — and a working command of the LLM behavior, evaluation, and failure modes needed to reason about and verify agentic solutions in production. This is not an AI research or foundation-model role.
  • ServiceNow platform and CRM & Industry domain. Knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and the CRM & Industry domains this role serves — sales automation, CPQ, customer service, and field service — is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Solution architecture and integration. Expert-level system design makes sound architecture and sequencing decisions under uncertainty, designs end-to-end solutions across systems and data, and judges what to build, buy, or configure to meet the outcome. Defines architectural patterns that hold across multiple customer engagements.
  • Verification, security, and reliability. A disciplined, skeptical eye for whether output meets intent, plus working knowledge of the security and reliability risks specific to AI-integrated systems and how to control them with concrete, least-privilege practices, monitoring, and rollback.
  • Customer engagement and communication. Excellent communication and stakeholder skills — able to run discovery and working sessions, influence customer technical and executive audiences, and clearly convey capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, and risk.
  • Technical leadership. A record of leading and coaching engineers — including senior engineers — setting reusable technical standards across teams and elevating the delivery capability of a group rather than only individual output.
  • Education. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees or relevant certifications are a plus but do not substitute for demonstrated ability to deliver reliable AI solutions to customers.
  • Years of Experience. 15 years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree in computer science; or 12 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 8 years’ experience; or equivalent experience. Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees or relevant certifications are a plus but are not a substitute for demonstrated ability to ship reliable software with AI-native practices.

What you can expect: a front-row seat in ServiceNow’s fastest-growing, most strategic business, direct access to senior customers and executives, and the room to define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. The technical foundation and the team you build here grow with the business — and so does your impact and career.

descriptionHtml:

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Position Overview:

The Executive Assistant is a force multiplier and operational partner to the Senior Executive Assistant, supporting the executive office of the President and Chief Financial Officer. This role focuses on event execution, communications support, administrative operations, and after-hours backup. This is not a 100% remote role. The position will require working both in a professional office environment and in the executive’s residential space, based in Los Angeles or Orange County Area. The Executive Assistant reports to the Senior Executive Assistant but serves as an extension of the CFO, partnering closely with the CFO on priorities and execution while collaborating with the Senior Executive Assistant on complex or executive-facing decisions 

The Sr. EA retains ownership of calendar management, strategic cross-functional coordination, executive communications strategy, and complex vendor relationships. The Executive Assistant amplifies the Sr. EA's capacity by owning execution on defined operational areas.  

Key Responsibilities: 

Key Distinctions: This Role vs. Senior Executive Assistant: 

Executive Assistant OWNS:  

  • Event execution and vendor logistics  

  • Routine communications and scheduling  

  • Administrative operations and documentation  

  • After-hours urgent support  

Senior Executive Assistant OWNS:  

  • Calendar strategy and all hold decisions  

  • Executive communications strategy and messaging  

  • Cross-functional coordination and stakeholder relationships  

  • Compliance and governance decisions  

  • Strategic project coordination  

  • All executive-facing interactions and decisions  

  • Supervision and direction of Executive Assistant role  

  • Travel logistics coordination (managed through external Travel Manager) 

Event Coordination & Logistics:  

  • Execute event planning and logistics under Sr. EA strategic direction, including departmental meetings, executive office events, and organization-wide initiatives (e.g., holiday parties, town halls, all-hands meetings)  

  • Provide both professional and personal support to the executive, balancing business priorities with personal needs and responsibilities. 

  • Manage vendor coordination, catering, transportation, and on-site setup  

  • Track RSVPs, attendee confirmations, and special accommodations  

  • Proactively anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and ensure seamless execution of both professional and personal responsibilities.

  • Ensure all prep materials for upcoming meetings are available and accounted for; track meeting attendees and flag status to Sr. EA to determine next steps  

  • Ensure materials and run-of-show documents are available to President and CFO  

  • Handle post-event follow-up and execute event troubleshooting and real-time problem-solving  

Communications Support & Coordination, Under SR EA guidance: 

  • Manage routine email processing, routing, and responses  

  • Coordinate scheduling emails, meeting confirmations, and calendar updates  

  • Maintain communication logs and prepare executive communication summaries  

Calendar & Scheduling Support: 

  • Maintain calendar accuracy and update logistics for confirmed meetings  

  • Monitor the calendar for conflicts and flag to Sr. EA immediately  

  • Prepare weekly calendar reviews and highlight key activities for Sr. EA  

  • Coordinate with external participants on scheduling logistics  

  • Coordinate day-to-day logistics, scheduling, and organizational needs across residential and professional settings.

  • Support scheduling calls and meeting coordination under Sr. EA direction  

Administrative Operations & Support:  

  • Maintain OCFO filing systems, databases, and operational documentation  

  • Maintain the highest standards of discretion, confidentiality, flexibility, attention to detail, and sound judgment.

  • Prepare executive materials: reports, presentations, briefing documents  

  • Handle office management and supply ordering  

  • Process expenses, reimbursements, and financial documentation  

  • Manage shared calendars, scheduling tools, and software administration  

  • Organize and maintain the executive’s residential space and office environment, ensuring both are well-organized and efficiently managed. 

Cross-Functional Coordination:  

  • Execute multi-executive scheduling logistics under Sr. EA strategy  

  • Set up meetings and coordinate follow-up on Sr. EA direction  

  • Manage operational details with internal stakeholders  

  • Document meetings, action items, and deliverables  

  • Serve as escalation point for operational issues  

Team Operations & Knowledge Management: 

  • Assist with EA team scheduling and coordination  

  • Update and maintain EA playbooks and operational documentation  

  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer procedures  

  • Maintain shared team resources and calendars  

  • Document processes and operational best practices  

After-Hours & Urgent Support: 

  • Handle urgent after-hours requests and escalate appropriately  

  • Maintain communication during business-critical situations  

  • Escalate all executive-facing decisions to Sr. EA  

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Competencies: 

  • 5+ years as an Executive assistant 

  • This position will require trips to the Bay Area 

  • Experience supporting C-suite or senior executive team  

  • Social media skills, including creating and managing content across platforms 

  • Strong organizational and project management skills; ability to manage multiple priorities  

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; professional correspondence ability  

  • Ability to work independently and follow Sr. EA direction without constant oversight  

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and logistics  

  • Ability to remain calm and problem-solve in high-pressure environments  

  • Proficiency with Outlook, Teams, Office 365, and calendar management software  

  • Demonstrated ability to follow processes and escalate appropriately  

  • Flexible, adaptable, and willing to adjust priorities as needed  

  • Discretion and professionalism in handling confidential information  

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Event planning and coordination experience  

  • Experience with vendor management and contract coordination  

  • Knowledge of financial operations or compliance requirements  

  • Experience working as part of a larger administrative team  

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Sr. EA can delegate event execution without micromanaging logistics  

  • Routine communications are handled professionally without Sr. EA involvement  

  • Executive-facing communications always go through Sr. EA before delivery  

  • Calendar logistics are executed perfectly; Sr. EA owns the calendar strategy  

  • Urgent after-hours issues are handled competently or escalated immediately  

Work Environment & Expectations: 

  • Fast-paced environment with competing priorities and time-sensitive requests  

  • Occasional after-hours support for urgent executive needs  

  • Collaboration with Sr. EA, finance teams, compliance, and cross-functional partners  

  • High level of professionalism and confidentiality required  

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing circumstances and priorities  

  • Support role—all executive decisions and strategy owned by Sr. EA

title: Director -Commercial Sales
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

This is a senior sales leadership role responsible for building and running a high-performing commercial sales team across India's commercial (non-named) account segment. You will own the new business target for India for the Commercial Segment, setting the strategy, designing the territory model, and coaching your team to execute a disciplined sales motion across a portfolio of accounts. You will also ensure a close liaison with the ServiceNow Partner team as well as with a set of focused partners across the region, who will help with demand generation and sales progression in this segment. You will operate at the intersection of sales leadership, partner strategy, and India market expertise, working cross-functionally with your own team, Partner Managers, Marketing, Pre-Sales, and Excellence groups to ensure your team has everything needed to win. 

What you get to do in this role: 

  • Team leadership and development: Hire, onboard, and develop a commercial sales team across India's industry verticals. Set clear performance expectations, run structured 1:1s and pipeline reviews, and coach reps through complex deal cycles. Build a high-accountability, high-support team culture aligned to ServiceNow's values. 

  • India partner-led sales strategy: Define the partner led go-to-market strategy for India's non-named account segment. Determine territory design, industry vertical coverage (FSI, MRD, TMT, Public Sector), and partner selection criteria. Translate strategy into executable territory plans with each PSM and ensure quarterly execution discipline. 

  • Revenue ownership: Own and deliver the team's new business quota for India. Maintain accurate pipeline visibility, manage forecast calls, and take early corrective action on coverage gaps. Identify and escalate deal risks while keeping momentum on the team's top opportunities. 

  • Partner ecosystem leadership: Work with the ServiceNow Partner Manager Group to shape the right partner mix for India by industry vertical, geography within India, and solution capability. Elevate partner relationships at the leadership level, supporting your PSMs in building strong working relationships with selected partners' sales teams. 

  • Demand generation and pipeline creation: Collaborate with the Partner Marketing Group to build and execute joint demand generation programmes across India's key verticals and partner ecosystem. Ensure pipeline creation targets are met through a balanced mix of partner-led events, digital campaigns, and direct prospecting with your team. 

  • Executive engagement and deal support: Engage directly with C-suite and senior buyer stakeholders on strategic opportunities both to advance deals and to model the right level of executive engagement for your PSMs. Support the team in navigating complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles with partner and internal pre-sales resources. 

  • India market and industry expertise: Bring credible knowledge of India's enterprise technology landscape across key verticals FSI, MRD, TMT, and Public Sector. Understand the competitive dynamics, procurement patterns, partner ecosystem maturity, and digital transformation priorities specific to India's commercial market. 

  • Reporting and business rhythm: Establish and maintain a regular operating cadence of weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly planning sessions with your team, partners, and APAC leadership. Provide clear, data-driven reporting on team performance, pipeline health, and market trends. 
     

    Qualifications

    To be successful in this role you have:
     

    • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 

    • Sales leadership track record: 8 to 12+ years in B2B technology sales, including 3 to 5+ years leading a sales team with direct quota ownership. Experience is Commercial Sales will be an aded advantage. Consistent track record of building teams that deliver against new business targets in the enterprise or commercial SaaS segment. 

    • Channel and partner sales: Deep experience building and executing partner-led sales motions by co-selling with partners, managing partner-influenced pipeline, and driving partner accountability for revenue outcomes. Knows the difference between managing partners and selling through them. 

    • India enterprise market expertise: Strong understanding of India's enterprise technology landscape, including major buying centres, procurement dynamics, key partner ecosystems (SIs, VARs, GSIs with India presence), and the competitive SaaS environment. Local network is a significant advantage. 

    • Industry vertical knowledge: Working knowledge across India's priority verticals: Financial Services (FSI), Manufacturing / Retail & Distribution (MRD), Technology / Media / Telecom (TMT), and Public Sector. Able to coach PSMs on vertical-specific positioning and to engage credibly with senior industry buyers. 

    • Enterprise SaaS platform fluency: Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms, ideally ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, or comparable workflow / ITSM / ERP solutions. Able to position platform value at business and IT decision-maker level and coach reps to do the same. 

    • People leadership and coaching: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain strong sales talent. Brings a structured coaching approach, uses deal reviews, call shadowing, and pipeline inspection to lift team performance. Creates an environment where PSMs are set up to succeed. 

    • Cross-functional leadership: Experienced at operating as a senior stakeholder in a matrixed organisation by aligning partner, marketing, pre-sales, and enablement resources around a common revenue goal. Influences without direct authority and builds trusted relationships across functions. 

    • AI fluency: Leverages AI tools to drive team productivity such as pipeline prioritisation, account research, deal coaching, and performance analysis. Able to articulate AI-powered product value to business buyers and coach the team to do the same.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Role

ServiceNow is formalizing Exclusive Networks as its authorized distributor for EMEA, extending our two-tier channel model into the European Union and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The Senior GTM Operations Manager, Distribution will own the onboarding and day-to-day operation of Exclusive Networks, from standing up operating frameworks to activating reseller partners and driving compliant, predictable revenue.

This is a hands-on operational role at a program launch. The person in this role will be the primary operational point of contact between ServiceNow and the distributor, and will protect program integrity while accelerating time to revenue. Because the EU and KSA operate under different regulatory, commercial, and cultural conditions, this role must be based in-region and cannot be absorbed by a US-based or globally stretched resource.

Key Responsibilities

Distributor operating framework

  • Design and stand up the operational framework for Exclusive Networks across the EU and KSA, including processes, roles, service levels, and escalation paths.
  • Define the operating cadence (business reviews, forecast calls, issue triage) and the documentation that governs it.
  • Establish clear decision rights between ServiceNow and the distributor for pricing, deal registration, partner eligibility, and exceptions.

Reseller activation and onboarding

  • Own the end-to-end reseller onboarding process through Exclusive Networks, from partner qualification through certification, enablement, and first deal.
  • Work with the distributor’s partner teams to build activation plans and track partner readiness against targets.
  • Identify enablement gaps and coordinate with ServiceNow partner enablement to close them.

Deal flow and revenue operations

  • Manage deal flow from reseller registration through quote, order, fulfillment, and booking, and resolve bottlenecks as they arise.
  • Monitor pipeline and bookings data from the distributor and produce regular performance reporting for ServiceNow leadership.
  • Ensure transactions meet ServiceNow program rules, pricing governance, and contract terms.

Prebuy and inventory coordination

  • Coordinate prebuy and inventory structures with the distributor where applicable, including forecasting, replenishment, and working capital considerations.
  • Track inventory positions and flag risk early to protect margin and commitments.

Compliance and jurisdictional management

  • Ensure the distributor’s operations align with requirements across EU member-state and KSA regulations, including tax and invoicing obligations, customs and export controls, data protection, and local commercial rules.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Trade Compliance to resolve jurisdiction-specific questions before they become program issues.

Stakeholder management

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact between ServiceNow and Exclusive Networks.
  • Build working relationships with ServiceNow regional sales leaders, partner managers, and central GPC functions, and represent the distributor’s operational needs internally.
  • Escalate issues with clear options and recommendations, and drive them to resolution.

Performance and continuous improvement

  • Define and track KPIs for distributor performance, partner activation, and time to revenue.
  • Identify process improvements as the program scales from launch and document lessons learned.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in channel operations, distribution management, or indirect sales operations, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead capacity.
  • Direct experience managing or operationalizing a distributor or channel partner program in EMEA.
  • Working knowledge of multi-jurisdictional operations across the EU and the GCC, with specific experience in or exposure to KSA.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and commercial requirements that affect distribution, including VAT and indirect tax, customs and export controls, and Saudi e-invoicing (ZATCA) requirements.
  • Strong operational discipline: able to translate a launch plan into a working system, track it, and adjust.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English. Fluency in Arabic is strongly preferred for the KSA market.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across functions (Sales, Finance, Legal, Partner Management) and influence without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with Excel and business reporting tools. Experience with CRM and partner management platforms is expected.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across EU markets and to KSA.
  • Authorization to work in the role’s country of location.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a major technology distributor or value-added reseller.
  • Experience launching a new distribution model or distributor onboarding in a new region.
  • Familiarity with prebuy, floor-plan, or inventory financing structures.
  • Experience operating in Saudi Arabia, including familiarity with local partnership norms and Saudization (Nitaqat) requirements.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and EU data-handling requirements.
  • Experience with ServiceNow’s partner ecosystem or a comparable enterprise software program.

Core Competencies

  • Operational ownership: Takes an ambiguous launch and turns it into a working, measured system.
  • Cross-cultural judgment: Adapts communication and expectations across EU and KSA stakeholders without losing program standards.
  • Commercial acumen: Understands how deal flow, margin, and inventory interact, and flags risk before it hits the P&L.
  • Influence without authority: Gets alignment across functions and organizations that do not report to the role.
  • Bias for speed: Moves quickly to unblock partners and the distributor while keeping compliance intact.

The Business 

Technology Workflows is the largest business at ServiceNow – and its core.  We build the products that run the technology estate— Service Management (Incident/Problem/Change), Operations Management (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, etc.), the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Asset Management, and Portfolio Management. Our customers use us to gain visibility of their technology estate, understand how it connects and performs, and act on it. 

As AI moves from helping people work to acting on systems directly, the accuracy and reach of that picture becomes the limit on everything built above it. That puts the Technology Workflows business at the center of the company’s agentic strategy. 

The Role 

This is a senior individual contributor role and the strategy partner to the SVP of Technology Workflows and the General Managers and Product Leaders of each business unit.  You will not run a product line directly, nor will not have a team reporting directly to you.  Your work and impact come through the ability to partner and influence.  You will decide what this business should believe about where its market is going, be the key identifier of technological shifts and trends, and understand the current and future competitive landscape.  You will synthesize your findings with evidence and turn it into artifacts that help set long-term roadmap direction, budget allocations, staffing decisions, pricing, partnerships, and acquisitions.  You will interact with the ServiceNow Ventures team to help identify and assess sectors and individual companies for investment, with the Corporate Development team to create M&A chess boards and evaluate acquisition targets, and with the Corporate Strategy team to develop ServiceNow’s overall strategic posture. 

Key to this role is a understanding of both business and deep technical constructs.  Technology Workflows is the most technical product group at ServiceNow and success in this role requires understanding how technical estates are run and the constantly changing stack used by practitioners. 

If you want a defined product area and a team to build it, this is the wrong role. If you want to set the direction of a business at this scale without the machinery of owning it, few seats give you this much reach. 

What you get to do in this role 

  • Own and defend the multi-year strategic position for Technology Workflows, and keep it current as the AI landscape moves. Produce the written arguments and pre-reads that leadership actually decides from. 

  • Set market sizing and category definition for the business, including where the current and future addressable market genuinely is rather than where the analyst taxonomy says it is. 

  • Shape pricing and packaging strategy across the portfolio, including the shift of consumption-based products toward outcome-based models, in partnership with product managers, pricing, finance, and the platform packaging teams. 

  • Own inorganic strategy for the business: source and evaluate acquisition, acquihire, and partnership candidates across the Technology Workflows portfolio.  Form a technical point of view, convene product and engineering diligence, and hand corporate development and Technology Workflows leadership a recommendation with a thesis attached. 

  • Build and maintain the partner and ecosystem framework—which partners matter, why, and how each one fits—across multiple categories such as observability, endpoint, operational technology, and systems integrator relationships. 

  • Represent the business in executive and customer forums, including the CIO Product Advisory Council, the annual strategy cycle, and the twelve-month product roadmap review. Write the content, present it live, and carry the commitments it creates. 

  • Maintain the competitive picture for AI-native technology operations and surface how our own products and packaging must evolve with how the market is being sold. 

  • Partner across product leadership for service management, operations, configuration, asset management and portfolio management, plus Platform, AI, pricing, marketing, and analyst relations—with influence rather than authority. 

To be successful in this role you have 

  • Strong analytical and presentation skills in deeply technical fields.  An engineering degree with 10+ years of product leadership/product development experience and an MBA with 10+ years of business leadership and execution are assets. 

  • 15+ years in enterprise software with a focus on technical IT or production operations – or direct experience running technical estates, with significant time spent operating at or alongside the executive table 

  • Deep domain knowledge in how hardware and software is built, deployed, and run, and the tooling and tech stacks involved.  You must be able to hold a technical conversation with a startup CTO and tell whether the architecture claim is real.  You must be able to converse with customers and practitioners in their own vernacular and understand how they do their work and the ecosystem of tools they use to get it done. 

  • Experience with development and ownership of a strategic position that changed what a business did—not a deck that circulated, a decision that moved. 

  • Experience evaluating companies for acquisition, acquihire, or deep partnership, including forming an independent technical view and coordinating diligence across product and engineering. 

  • Strong commercial instincts across pricing, packaging, and market sizing 

  • Strong analytical skills and the willingness to challenge an analysis you were handed. 

  • Exceptional written communication. This role persuades senior leaders in prose and in pre-reads, often before ever presenting live. 

  • Executive presence with external audiences, including large enterprise CIOs and startup founders. You will be the most senior product voice in the room more often than not. 

  • Comfort operating without a team. You build coalitions, borrow capacity, and get outcomes through people who do not report to you. 

  • Experience integrating AI into work processes, strategic direction, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, reviewing AI-influenced insights, or examining how AI changes your function or industry. 

  • A strong full-stack understanding of on-premise infrastructure, the public cloud, DevOps practices, how software is created/deployed/run, and the tooling and engineering practices along the way. 

Nice to have 

  • Background spanning both the IT estate and the production/DevOps estate.

This team is approx. 70 ICs and 14 managers. This is an execution role at heart. You will re-establish a tight connection between the field and CRM product, build the next generation of pre-sales talent around the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) model, and lead the shift from a demo-centric to a proof-of-value (POV) centric go-to-market motion. Build the next-generation pre-sales organization (FDE model)

  • Work with CRM selling peers—sales, product, value, and partner leaders—as one integrated engine of execution, not adjacent functions.

  • Deep understanding of the CRM market and the disruption that AI and agentic automation are bringing to it.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

This is a high-impact role at the center of how the Employee Experience Group sets its direction, places its bets, and scales. The Director of Strategy & Operations will work alongside senior product leadership to shape the business strategy, translate market opportunities into investment priorities, and build the operating model needed to deliver durable growth.

You will bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance around the decisions that matter most—from where to invest and how to win in the market to how success is measured. You will lead annual and long-range planning, develop the market and competitive insights that inform our choices, and turn strategy into focused, coordinated execution across the business.

We are looking for a trusted advisor and hands-on builder—someone who sees around corners, brings structure to ambiguity, and can move fluidly from executive-level strategy to the work required to make it real. The right leader will combine sharp business judgment, analytical depth, and strong influence with the energy to build what does not yet exist.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to product and business leadership, providing analysis and recommendations on priorities, investment choices, operating tradeoffs, and execution plans
  • Own the business unit’s annual and long-range planning and financial modeling, including forecasting, annual operating plans, OKRs, budget, and headcount in partnership with Finance
  • Develop outside-in perspectives on the employee experience and enterprise AI markets, including market sizing, growth drivers, customer trends, and competitive dynamics
  • Translate complex, ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and executable plans
  • Own the business unit’s planning and operating cadences, business reviews, and executive reporting to create visibility, accountability, and alignment across leadership
  • Define the KPIs, targets, dashboards, and performance frameworks used to assess business health, growth, and execution
  • Partner with and influence Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance on go-to-market strategy, providing analysis and recommendations on pricing and packaging, sales plays, and growth opportunities
  • Identify operating gaps and design scalable processes, decision mechanisms, and systems that improve execution velocity and organizational effectiveness
  • Partner on high-priority cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation, influencing clear ownership, milestones, risk management, and measurable outcomes
  • Build the first version when needed—developing analyses, tools, processes, and operating mechanisms before scaling them through the organization

Qualifications

What you'll need to succeed in this role

  • 10–12+ years of overall experience, including either 2+ years of management consulting experience combined with 4+ years of product strategy experience at a SaaS or AI company, or 6+ years of product strategy experience at a SaaS or AI company
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex business planning, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives with measurable results
  • Strong strategic and analytical judgment, including the ability to develop hypotheses, build structured analyses, interpret data, and translate findings into decisions; hands-on financial modeling capability, with the ability to create models and review and challenge analyst output
  • Experience partnering with senior executives and influencing across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Finance in a matrixed organization
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and create clear executive-level narratives
  • A hands-on, outcome-oriented approach and a track record of building practical solutions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Experience with go-to-market strategy and pricing and packaging is preferred
  • People leadership experience is preferred

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

What you get to do in this role: 

About the Team 

The Strategy, Planning, and Operations (SPO) team serves as the strategic engine of the Customer Excellence Group (CEG) organization. Within SPO, the Central Strategy team drives high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that shape strategy, improve execution, and accelerate performance across the business, spanning Strategy, Initiative Delivery, Strategic Programs, and Realization. 

The Analytics + Insights pillar sits within Central Strategy and leads CEG’s analytics function. It turns data into insights that strengthen customer health, accelerate adoption, and directly inform leadership decisions. The pillar owns CEG executive scorecards, OKR metrics and targets, corporate OKR and SPM reporting, and Quarterly Impact Insights, and supports the AI Command Center, Global Forecast Call, and Mission Control. We are a lean team, so prioritization and simplification are part of everyone’s job. 

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Analytics & Insights who can turn executive reporting into strategic decisions. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports. 

CEG’s scorecards, OKR/SPM reporting, and Quarterly Impact Insights are the foundation of the role. You will be accountable for their accuracy and narrative, and you will use them as your early-warning system: spotting emerging issues, connecting signals across reporting streams, and deciding what deserves a deeper look. You will then build the model or analysis, and bring the CEG Leadership Team a clear recommendation and a plan for follow-through with partners across product, engineering, sales, marketing, finance, and customer success. 

This is a hands-on role. Recurring analytical reporting is real work that comes with the job. The expectation is that you use what it shows to set and drive the analytical agenda. 

What You’ll Do 

Run the reporting engine 

  • Be accountable for CEG executive scorecards across global, geo, and major-area views, including commentary on what changed, why, and what leadership should do about it. 

  • Define and maintain CEG OKR metrics and targets, along with adoption and downsell reporting. 

  • Run the corporate OKR/SPM reporting cycle with metric owners, and make sure figures reconcile across scorecards, OKR submissions, and executive materials before they reach leadership. 

  • Own the analysis and executive narrative for Quarterly Impact Insights, working with Finance on the underlying data. 

  • Contribute account-level analysis and metrics to the AI Command Center and the Global Forecast Call. Stay fluent in the weekly D&L forecast and Partner 360 ROI so you can connect them to your analyses. 

Find what matters and analyze it 

  • Review each reporting cycle for emerging risks, anomalies, and open questions, and decide which warrant deeper analysis. 

  • Structure ambiguous problems, form hypotheses, and build driver-based models and scenarios that quantify what is at stake and what would change the outcome. 

  • Deliver strategic analyses that end in a recommendation, a named decision-maker, and agreed next steps. 

  • Turn recurring ad hoc requests, such as Impact coverage analysis and account enrichment for undeployed backlog work, into planned analyses instead of one-off scrambles. 

  • Drive follow-through with cross-functional partners, influencing without direct authority. 

Make the system better 

  • Reduce manual consolidation through automation, standard templates, and consistent metric definitions across reporting streams. 

  • Recommend which reports and metrics to simplify, merge, or retire based on how leaders actually use them. 

  • Apply AI where it improves the speed or quality of analysis, and evaluate critically where it doesn’t. 

Qualifications

Required 

  • Experience: 8+ years in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, or strategy and operations roles, where rigorous analysis and executive decision support were core to the job. We value the modeling discipline these paths build, and we also welcome analytics leaders from technology companies who can show the same. 

  • Modeling and analytical rigor: Advanced Excel (or equivalent) with demonstrated experience building financial or operational models that informed an executive decision. You can show us a model you built and explain the judgment behind it. 

  • Strategic problem-solving: Experience structuring ambiguous problems, finding the signal in recurring metrics, and recommending a course of action. 

  • Executive communication: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders through clear storytelling and analytical confidence. 

  • Collaboration: Experience in a matrixed environment, aligning stakeholders and following through on recommendations without direct authority. 

  • Ownership of delivery: Comfortable owning recurring reporting with high accuracy, and using it as the starting point for deeper work. 

Preferred 

  • Experience owning executive scorecards, OKR or operating-metric reporting, or quarterly business reviews. 

  • Power BI and experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake. 

  • Working knowledge of SaaS business drivers such as adoption, renewal, and expansion. 

  • Experience using AI to improve analysis, decision-making, or operational processes.

title: Senior Reliability Engineer - Veza
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources—providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

You'll architect scalable solutions, navigate complex technical challenges independently, and deliver results under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.   • Conduct technical onboarding and provide expert guidance on platform architecture and best practices
  • Create customer-facing documentation, troubleshooting guides, and run-books
  • Lead customer calls and technical discussions as a trusted advisor


Team Development

  • Mentor SRE and engineering team members, elevating technical capabilities
  • Foster a culture of reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • US Citizenship Required — role requires or may require federal security clearance
  • BS degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 7+ years in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-team infrastructure projects from conception to production
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously on ambiguous projects with tight deadlines
  • Hands-on experience with major compliance frameworks (SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP Moderate/High) including infrastructure automation for control implementation and continuous audit evidence collection

Technical Expertise

  • 5+ years with AWS (VPC, EC2, RDS, EKS, CloudFormation) and cloud automation
  • Expert-level experience with Kubernetes, Helm, Linux, and Terraform
  • Strong experience with GitOps model, distributed version control, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Proficiency with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog)
  • Strong programming/scripting skills (Python, Go, Bash) for automation and reading codes
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and reliability patterns
  • Experience with Bazel and CueLang a plus
  • Experience implementing compliance-as-code patterns and automated compliance scanning/remediation

Leadership & Communication

  • Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Track record of driving technical change across organizational boundaries
  • Successfully delivered multiple complex projects under tight deadlines
  • Strong customer service orientation with patience and empathy

Work Style

  • Hands-on, "can do" attitude with bias for action
  • Low ego and high intellectual curiosity
