Job Description

About the Team:
ServiceNow’s worldwide Customer Excellence Group (CEG) is a global network of employees and partners with a singular mission: to ensure customer success. We build trusted relationships, learn our customers’ businesses, and deliver value-based outcomes that make ServiceNow the best decision they ever made.

The CEG Strategy, Product, & Operations team (SPO) is the powerhouse that propels CEG forward. We are the strategic engine for the organization, driving org-wide programs to forge critical cross-functional partnerships to empower CEG's most vital initiatives, as well as providing the operational rhythm that powers BAU Operations.

The Role:

Reporting directly to the VP of CEG Global Field Ops, the Sr. Director, AMS Head of CEG Operations will lead the operational engine for the Customer Excellence Group (CEG) across the Americas. This role drives the strategy, planning, and execution that enable CEG's customer success and post-sale teams to deliver value-based outcomes at scale, owning the operating cadence, performance management, and cross-functional alignment that keep the AMS field running and growing. The AMS region represents CEG's largest and most complex geography, spanning multiple segments, Major Areas, and partner ecosystems—making this role one of the most consequential in the CEG SPO organization. The ideal candidate is a builder who thrives in ambiguity, pairs strong financial and analytical rigor with executive presence, operates with speed and urgency, and is energized by executing with excellence across a large, matrixed organization.

This role provides daily business partnership, and strategic operations support to the GVP, AMS CEG and his leadership team.   The individual will be looked upon to drive strategic transformation within AMS and help the team achieve its stated business objectives.

What you get to do in this role:

Strategic Leadership:

  • Define and execute the operational strategy and annual operating plan for CEG across the Americas, ensuring alignment with global CEG priorities and consistency across Geos and segments
  • Own the performance and health of the AMS field organization—tracking the metrics, targets, and forecasts that govern customer success, renewals, and expert services
  • Continuously improve the operating model, processes, and tooling that scale how the AMS field ops team plans, prioritizes, and delivers for their Geo and Major Area Leader counterparts
  • Translate global CEG strategy into AMS-specific priorities, ensuring the field has clear line-of-sight from corporate goals to on-the-ground execution
  • Partner with Finance and CEG leadership on headcount planning, resource allocation, and investment decisions across the AMS field
  • Partner with Sales leadership and Sales Operations in achieving mutually agreed upon goals around NNACV growth and risk mitigation.

 Executive Leadership:

  • Serve as a trusted thought and execution partner to the AMS CEG leadership team and SPO Leadership team
  • Build and cultivate high-level relationships across CEG, HR, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to align on shared goals and unblock execution
  • Represent AMS Field Ops in global SPO leadership forums, bringing the voice of the Americas into org-wide planning and prioritization decisions
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level communications, including QBR content, leadership briefings, and board-ready materials that tell the AMS story with clarity and impact

Operational Excellence:

  • Establish and run the operational cadences—quarterly business reviews, performance against key metrics, forecasting, and planning rhythms—with key stakeholders (Geo Leads, Major Area Leads, etc.)
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team, fostering a collaborative, high-impact culture
  • Act as a change agent, championing new processes and technologies that raise the bar on how the AMS field operations team supports the CEG AMS counterparts
  • Own the AMS capacity and coverage model, working closely with Workforce Planning and HR Business Partners to ensure the field is appropriately resourced to meet customer demand and growth targets
  • Drive consistency and accountability across AMS Major Areas through standardized reporting frameworks, escalation paths, and performance review cadences
  • Partner with the broader SPO team to identify, scope, and land high-priority programs that span the AMS field—from new initiative rollouts to post-merger integration workstreams

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated “AI-first” mindset and a relentless growth orientation
  • Strong data analytics, financial acumen, and problem-solving skills with ability to synthesize complex information
  • Demonstrated ability to be thought and execution partner to senior leaders to help run and develop their orgs
  • Bias toward action and an ownership mentality—results-oriented, and accountable for both successes and learnings
  • Track record of leading teams and developing talent with inclusive leadership
  • Proven success driving operational execution in complex, matrixed environments
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to influence without authority at the VP and SVP level
  • Experience navigating cross-functional stakeholder environments involving Finance, Legal, HR, and Sales
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism, and a commitment to ServiceNow's core values
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required, MBA or advanced degree preferred

Job Description

Eligibility

This position supports Government of Canada Protected B workloads. To be considered, you must:

  • Be a Canadian citizen or Canadian permanent resident.
  • Live in Canada and perform all work from within Canada.
  • Obtain and maintain Government of Canada Reliability Status. Screening requires five years of verifiable background history and includes identity verification, education verification, a criminal record check, and a credit check.

You don’t need to hold Reliability Status today. ServiceNow sponsors the screening through our Company Security Officer under Public Services and Procurement Canada’s Contract Security Program.

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT MEET THE ABOVE ELIGIBILITY, Thank you

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) 

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact

About the Role

ServiceNow’s Enterprise Security organization is seeking a versatile Senior Staff Security Systems Engineer to support multiple security engineering functions in our Canadian regulated environment. You’ll work across identity, vulnerability management, cloud and infrastructure security, security data platforms, and ServiceNow security operations. This role suits an engineer who enjoys breadth, solves problems across disciplines, and builds automation that scales.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for security engineering in the Canada regulated environment.
  • Engineer, harden, and operate security controls across on-premises, cloud, and isolated infrastructure.
  • Build automation and infrastructure-as-code that streamlines security engineering and operations, reporting, and remediation.
  • Partner with infrastructure, application, and platform owners to drive remediation and track compliance against CIS and NIST baselines.
  • Support security tooling across identity, vulnerability scanning, logging, and cloud security based on team priorities.
  • Produce operational and executive-facing reporting on security posture and performance.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on security or systems engineering experience in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Expert Linux administration and troubleshooting skills across OS internals, host networking, storage, virtualization, and containers. Proficiency with DNS, NTP, and LDAP services.
  • Proficiency in Python and Shell for production-grade automation and integrations.
  • Experience with DevOps methodologies: infrastructure-as-code and configuration management including Terraform, Ansible or Puppet; CI/CD pipelines; and Git-based workflows.
  • Expertise in network security fundamentals, including firewalls, segmentation, load balancers, and proxies.
  • Experience hardening systems against CIS, STIG, or NIST baselines and translating requirements into technical controls.
  • Experience using AI in your work, whether through AI-powered tools, automated workflows, AI-driven insights, or evaluating where AI can change how a function operates.
  • Understanding of Canada Protected B classification and data residency requirements for Canadian government systems.

Specialty Experience (Hands-On Experience in At Least Two Areas)

  • Identity and Access Management: PAM (BeyondTrust or CyberArk), SailPoint IIQ, or SSO platforms such as PingFederate or ForgeRock.
  • Vulnerability Management: Tenable SC and IO scan design and tuning, and risk-based prioritization using CVSS, EPSS, and known exploited vulnerability data.
  • Public Cloud Security: GCP security with working knowledge of AWS or Azure, Wiz, and CSPM, DSPM, or KSPM tooling.
  • Security Data Platforms: Distributed on-premises Splunk administration and Cribl Stream or Edge.
  • Infrastructure Security: OS hardening (SELinux, AppArmor, auditd), PKI and certificate lifecycle management, and container security.
  • ServiceNow Administrator: CSA certification or equivalent experience to manage and optimize our ServiceNow platform, including configuring workflows, maintaining user access and data integrity, supporting ITSM modules, and scripting (JavaScript, GlideScript) and ACLs, while partnering with stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.
  • ServiceNow Security Operations: Well versed in ServiceNow Security Operations applications such as Vulnerability Response, Configuration Compliance, and Security Incident Response.  

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, ServiceNow CSA, Tenable Certified Engineer, Cribl Admin, or a GCP security certification.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated, isolated, or air-gapped government environments.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes.

This role may require a higher level of security clearance in the future. Employment is conditional on successfully completing and maintaining the required screening. We can’t consider applications that don’t meet these requirements.

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. 

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise. 

Why This Role Matters:

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. 

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries.

  • System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments

title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM Workflows
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a CRM Solution Consultant for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities.

You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The CRM Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the CRM Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 
  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 
  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 
  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 
  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 
  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 
  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM Workflows
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the German market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities.

You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As an Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 
  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 
  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 
  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 
  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 
  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 
  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For 

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 
  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 
  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 
  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 
  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 
  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 

Qualifications 

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 
  • 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. 
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. 
  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. 
  • Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities.

title: Senior Product Specialist, Engage Central
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Job Description

This role exists to help ServiceNow partners adopt and succeed with Engage Central by combining solution consulting, onboarding and adoption, and first-line support in a single point of contact. 

In this role, you will be a key member of the Customer Excellence Group (CEG), reporting to the Engage Central Product Director and supporting the sales, onboarding, and adoption of Engage Central with ServiceNow partners. Engage Central is ServiceNow’s unified engagement platform that gives Expert Services and partner consultants a common, AI-native way to deliver accelerated implementations from discovery through go-live. 

This is a new, hybrid role that blends three disciplines: solution consulting, customer success, and first-line (L1) support. You will position and demonstrate Engage Central to partners, guide them through onboarding to productive use, and serve as their first point of contact when issues arise. You will work closely with Partner Managers, Partner Sales, Solution Consulting, CEG delivery, and the Engage Central product team. You will help build the motion, scale it to business-as-usual, and feed partner insight directly into the product roadmap. 

What you get to do in this role: 

Partner Sales & Solution Consulting 

  • Serve as the product and technical expert for Engage Central in partner sales cycles, working with Partner Managers, Partner Sales, and Solution Consultants to craft the value proposition for each partner 
  • Lead discovery sessions to understand partner delivery practices, challenges, and goals, and map them to Engage Central capabilities 
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations and proof-of-value sessions that show how Engage Central accelerates partner delivery 
  • Answer product feature, technical, security, and access questions from partners and ServiceNow colleagues 
  • Build and maintain reusable sales assets — demo scripts, pitch decks, FAQs, and objection handling — and share best practices across the team 
  • Track partner pipeline and adoption status, and report progress and forecast to the Engage Central Product Director 

Partner Onboarding & Adoption 

  • Own onboarding for a portfolio of partners, from kickoff and access provisioning through the first engagement delivered on Engage Central 
  • Build a success plan with each partner that sets clear adoption milestones and business outcomes 
  • Deliver enablement and training for partner leaders and consultants, and maintain onboarding guides, playbooks, and knowledge articles 
  • Monitor usage and adoption, identify at-risk partners early, and run targeted plays to drive deeper, sustained usage 
  • Capture partner success stories and use cases that demonstrate measurable value 
  • Coordinate with CEG delivery, Partner Managers, and the product team to ensure a seamless transition from sales to onboarding to steady state 

L1 Support & Issue Resolution 

  • Act as the first point of contact for partner questions and issues with Engage Central, including access, navigation, configuration, and how-to requests 
  • Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve L1 issues within agreed service levels; escalate complex issues to product and engineering with clear reproduction steps and business impact 
  • Track issues through resolution and keep partners informed along the way 
  • Assist in turning recurring issues into knowledge articles, FAQs, and self-service content that reduce future support volume 
  • Help define and improve the Engage Central support model, intake process, and service levels as the program scales 

Product Feedback & Continuous Improvement 

  • Serve as the voice of the partner, synthesizing insight from sales, onboarding, and support into clear, prioritized input for the product roadmap 
  • Participate in pilots, release reviews, and user acceptance testing to validate new capabilities before broad partner rollout 
  • Report regularly to leadership on adoption trends, support themes, and partner sentiment 
  • Identify opportunities to improve product usability based on feedback from partner and customers 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Experience supporting a new product launch or early-stage go-to-market motion 
  • Familiarity with support operations, including knowledge management and service levels (ITIL a plus) 
  • Experience in professional services delivery or consulting environments 
  • Knowledge of the ServiceNow partner ecosystem and partner delivery models 

Nice to have:

  • ServiceNow SPM certifications 
  • Travel, as necessary less than 20% 
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification 
  • Comfort working independently in a new, fast-changing role and building processes from the ground up 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences 
  • Experience working collaboratively with partners, professional services, product management, and sales teams 
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with comfort triaging issues and partnering with engineering to resolve them 
  • A track record of driving onboarding, adoption, and value realization across a portfolio of customers or partners 
  • Proven ability to run discovery and deliver compelling product demonstrations to technical and business audiences 
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or technical expertise with cloud software solutions 
  • 7+ years of related experience in solution consulting, pre-sales, customer success, or technical account management, ideally including customer or partner support

title: Senior Director, AI Platform Engineering Management
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The Role

The AI Control Tower is ServiceNow’s central hub for governing every AI model, agent, and dataset across the enterprise. We’re building the infrastructure enterprises will depend on as agentic AI moves from experimentation into production.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Engineering who combines the instincts of a startup builder with the leadership experience required to scale products, teams, and organizations. You have built products from zero to one, navigated the uncertainty of early customer adoption, and then created the engineering organization, architecture, and operating model required to scale.

This is not simply a role for someone who has managed mature platforms. We are looking for a leader who has built something from scratch, ideally in an environment where there was no established playbook, and who can bring that entrepreneurial mindset to the scale and ambition of ServiceNow.

Reporting to the VP of Engineering, AICT, you will lead multiple engineering teams and product areas across the AI Control Tower platform. You will help define the technical strategy, organizational structure, engineering culture, and execution model as the platform and organization grow.

You are AI-native. You do not just understand AI conceptually. You use it, build with it, and understand how AI changes product architecture, engineering workflows, developer productivity, and the expectations customers have for enterprise software.

What You Will Do

Engineering Strategy & Organizational Leadership
Own engineering strategy across multiple AICT product areas, translating the broader product vision into technical priorities, organizational investments, and execution plans. Partner with VP-level Product and Engineering leadership to determine where to invest, what to simplify, and how the platform should evolve as customer adoption accelerates.

Zero-to-One and Scaling to Adoption
Lead the full journey from initial product creation through meaningful enterprise adoption and scale. Establish feedback loops between customers, Product, Engineering, and Design so teams can quickly identify what is working, change what is not, and turn early customer traction into durable adoption.

Technical Leadership & Architecture
Provide senior technical leadership across architecture, platform strategy, data architecture, APIs, reliability, security, and operational scale. Establish architectural principles that allow multiple teams to move quickly without creating long-term platform fragmentation or technical debt. Stay close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions, review critical architectural decisions, and engage deeply when the situation requires it.

AI-Native Engineering
Set the strategy and expectations for how AI is used across the engineering organization. Drive adoption of AI throughout product definition, architecture, implementation, code review, debugging, testing, security, CI/CD, observability, operations, and documentation. Create measurable improvements in engineering productivity, software quality, reliability, customer experience, and delivery velocity.

Organization Building & Talent Leadership
Build and scale a high-performing engineering organization, including hiring and developing senior engineering managers, architects, technical leaders, and engineers. Create strong leadership succession, raise the technical bar, and establish a culture of accountability, experimentation, customer obsession, and continuous learning.

Portfolio & Roadmap Execution
Own execution across multiple teams and interconnected initiatives. Create mechanisms for prioritization, dependency management, technical decision-making, and delivery while ensuring teams remain responsive to a rapidly evolving AI market.

Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership
Partner closely with Product Management, Design, Security, Data, Infrastructure, and other engineering organizations. Represent AICT engineering in executive planning, architecture, investment, and product reviews. Communicate complex technical and organizational decisions clearly to senior leaders and influence priorities across organizational boundaries.

Customer & Market Leadership
Engage with strategic customers and field teams to understand how enterprises are deploying and governing AI in production. Translate customer problems into platform capabilities and use direct customer feedback to shape technical and product strategy.

Qualifications

Required

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading large, complex engineering organizations and managing managers and senior technical leaders
  • Proven experience operating at the Director or Senior Director level, or equivalent scope, with accountability across multiple engineering teams or product areas
  • Demonstrable startup or zero-to-one experience where you personally helped build, launch, and scale a new product or platform, ideally in an organization with fewer than 100 employees
  • Proven experience taking an early-stage or 1.0 product through customer adoption and into meaningful scale, including navigating product-market uncertainty and changing direction based on customer behavior
  • Deep technical foundation in cloud-native SaaS, including multi-tenant architectures, large-scale API design such as REST and gRPC, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and multi-cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code and modern cloud operations, including technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, and Helm
  • Strong understanding of database architecture, schema design, data modeling, and modern data platforms, including relational, graph, vector, columnar, OLAP, streaming, and event-driven architectures
  • Experience designing scalable data architectures that support AI, analytics, governance, and enterprise workloads
  • Proven ability to define technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams while balancing speed, reliability, security, scalability, and long-term maintainability
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI across the engineering lifecycle, including product strategy, architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, observability, operations, and developer productivity
  • Ability to operate comfortably from executive strategy and organizational design to architecture and implementation details when required
  • Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional engineering leaders and technical talent
  • Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence engineering, product, and business leaders across organizational boundaries

Preferred

  • Experience building governance, observability, compliance, or enterprise platform products where auditability, security, and explainability are core product requirements
  • Experience building or operating AI platforms, agentic systems, or AI infrastructure in production
  • Understanding of the operational realities of production AI agents, including tool reliability, context management, evaluation, observability, security, and failure modes
  • Background in enterprise security, IAM, data governance, or privacy
  • Familiarity with AI interoperability and integration standards such as MCP and OpenAPI
  • Experience engaging directly with large enterprise customers during the development and scaling of a new platform
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field

Job Description

About Flow by ServiceNow

Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are.

Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us.

Job Description

We are hiring a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer to be the most senior technical authority for Flow customers, guiding strategic and enterprise accounts from first demo and trial to long-term, expanding success. You will lead the hardest customer deployments, architect solutions that go beyond what the product does today, and turn what you learn in the field into product strategy. You will also raise the bar for the entire forward deployed team by setting technical standards, building repeatable playbooks, and mentoring other engineers. The role combines deep technical implementation, strategic customer partnership, and cross-functional leadership.

Ready to turn “we’re stuck” into “we’re live” for the most complex enterprise environments? You will own outcomes across multiple strategic customers, influence the Flow roadmap, and define how ServiceNow deploys AI-native products in the field.

What You Will Do

Technical Solutions and Architecture

  • Lead technical design and delivery for strategic enterprise deployments, including SSO and identity architecture, multi-system integrations, and security and compliance reviews with customer IT and security leadership.
  • Architect and build complex, production-grade automations and workflows with Flow’s natural-language builder across tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow.
  • Design knowledge and retrieval strategies across document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base, so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers at enterprise scale.
  • Solve problems the product does not yet handle by designing and documenting scalable workarounds, and convert them into reusable patterns, reference architectures, and product capabilities.
  • Lead proof-of-concept and strategic evaluation efforts, partnering with sales and executive stakeholders to demonstrate value and win competitive engagements.

Customer Success and Strategic Adoption

  • Define and continuously improve the onboarding and implementation motion so new customers set up and enable Flow in a few hours and reach production in one day.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer IT directors and executives, aligning Flow with their broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans.
  • Use Flow analytics on usage, conversation allowances, and automation results to build business cases, demonstrate value, and drive expansion from an initial use case to a full self-service service desk.
  • Own multi-account health and adoption outcomes, identifying risks early and driving executive-level resolution when needed.

Product Influence and Technical Leadership

  • Translate patterns across customers into clear product requirements and strategy, and partner with product management and engineering to prioritize and shepherd them through delivery.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer in roadmap, architecture, and go-to-market discussions, shaping how Flow is positioned, packaged, and priced.
  • Establish technical standards, playbooks, and tooling for the forward deployed function, and scale them across teams.
  • Mentor and coach solutions engineers at IC3 and IC4 levels and act as an escalation point for the most difficult issues.

Support and Reliability

  • Serve as the final technical escalation for critical customer issues such as API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, and failed automations, and drive them from diagnosis to durable resolution.
  • Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them, including systemic issues affecting multiple customers.
  • Use Flow health, audit, and activity logs to diagnose complex issues, identify outages, and define monitoring and triage practices that improve reliability for all customers.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software, including experience leading strategic, multi-system deployments.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with the ability to design integration architectures and debug them at depth.
  • Expert knowledge of single sign-on and identity architectures, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID, and of enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Extensive experience with enterprise service management or collaboration platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
  • Strong understanding of AI and workflow automation, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, and evaluating the quality and accuracy of AI answers.
  • Proven ability to communicate and influence from system administrators and security engineers to IT directors and executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect customer outcomes to broader IT and operations strategy and to ServiceNow’s plans.
  • Track record of technical leadership and mentorship, and of influencing product direction and cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Preferred 

  • Experience with service desk offerings.
  • Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products.
  • Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software.
  • Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion, playbooks, or a forward deployed function from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

You will partner with engineering and product leaders to translate business and customer needs into a coherent platform architecture and lead the execution of strategic, cross-organizational technical initiatives.

The ideal candidate is a recognized technical leader with deep expertise in large-scale distributed systems and enterprise platforms, exceptional architectural judgment, and a proven ability to influence engineering strategy and deliver measurable outcomes across teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Platform Architecture and Technical Strategy

  • Define and evolve the long-term architecture and technical strategy for ServiceNow Core Platform, ensuring foundational capabilities support enterprise scale, extensibility, security, performance, and reliability.

  • Own architectural direction across multiple platform domains, establishing principles, standards, and design patterns that promote consistency and reduce complexity.

  • Drive resolution of the most challenging architectural problems, balancing customer requirements, platform evolution, engineering efficiency, and long-term maintainability.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and modernize platform architecture, reduce technical debt, and improve separation of concerns across foundational services.

  • Influence platform roadmaps and investment decisions through clear architectural recommendations, technical analysis, and measurable business and customer outcomes.

2. Scalability, Performance, and Reliability

  • Architect solutions that enable the platform to scale efficiently across large numbers of customers, instances, workloads, and diverse usage patterns.

  • Drive improvements in runtime architecture, workload isolation, resource utilization, database access, service communication, and execution efficiency.

  • Establish architectural approaches for resilience, fault isolation, graceful degradation, and predictable performance under varying workloads.

  • Use telemetry, performance data, and production insights to identify systemic bottlenecks and prioritize high-impact architectural improvements.

  • Champion engineering practices that prevent customer-impacting regressions and improve service reliability, availability, and operational excellence.

3. Cross-Organizational Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture for strategic initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams and platform domains, driving alignment on technical direction and implementation trade-offs.

  • Partner with engineering, product management, security, and operations leaders to translate customer needs and business priorities into actionable architecture and engineering plans.

  • Influence senior technical and organizational leaders through strong technical judgment, data-driven analysis, and clear communication.

  • Mentor principal and senior engineers and technical leaders, raising the quality of architectural thinking and engineering execution across the organization.

4. Engineering Excellence and Platform Innovation

  • Drive architectural improvements that accelerate engineering delivery while maintaining high standards for quality, compatibility, and reliability.

  • Champion automation, continuous integration, contract testing, observability, and telemetry-driven engineering practices.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation in software development, testing, platform operations, and developer productivity.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches, translating promising innovations into practical, scalable platform capabilities.

  • Define measurable success criteria for architectural initiatives and ensure outcomes are validated through customer impact, engineering metrics, and operational results.

Qualifications

  • Extensive experience designing and evolving large-scale enterprise software platforms, distributed systems, or cloud-based SaaS architectures.

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant architectures, runtime platforms, service-oriented architectures, and foundational platform engineering.

  • Experience applying AI and automation to engineering productivity, software quality, and platform operations.

  • Experience architecting enterprise SaaS platforms operating at significant scale with extensive customer customization and integration requirements.

  • Proven ability to define architecture across multiple technical domains and lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of performance engineering, scalability, reliability, fault isolation, security, and operational resilience.

  • Deep knowledge of API architecture, platform extensibility, backward compatibility, and integration patterns.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence engineering strategy and technical decisions across organizational boundaries without relying on direct reporting relationships.

  • Exceptional architectural judgment, with the ability to evaluate complex trade-offs and translate technical strategy into incremental, executable plans.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and recommendations to senior engineering and executive leadership.

descriptionHtml:

Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a Principal Transformation Enterprise Architect to set the architectural direction for enterprise-wide transformation across our largest and most complex customers in our enterprise Industries team for the UK and Ireland. Working alongside business and technology leaders, you will shape the choices that determine how these organisations change. This is a senior individual-contributor role within our pre-sales solution consulting organisation, combining strategic judgement, architectural depth and executive influence. 

You will work where the problem is not yet clearly defined and the path forward is contested. Customers may be balancing competing business priorities, fragmented technology estates, established investments and demanding operational or regulatory constraints. Your role is to turn that complexity into a clear transformation direction: identify the business capabilities that need to change, evaluate architectural options and shape a practical roadmap that connects ambition, investment and measurable outcomes. 

As a trusted adviser to business executives, CIOs, CTOs and chief enterprise architects, you will challenge assumptions constructively and build alignment across business units, technology teams and partners. You will connect business strategy, operating-model change, enterprise architecture and technology investment—explaining the choices and trade-offs, not simply presenting a solution. 

Working with account leaders and specialist teams, you will provide architectural leadership on strategic sales opportunities. You will define how ServiceNow fits within the customer’s wider enterprise architecture, develop compelling transformation propositions and guide executive working sessions towards agreed decisions and priorities. You will maintain a credible path from the proposed architecture to delivery, working closely with customers, partners and implementation specialists. 

We are looking for someone who has already shaped significant, cross-functional transformation in complex enterprises. You will bring evidence of influencing executive decisions, resolving competing stakeholder priorities and setting architectural direction across multiple programmes. Technical expertise matters, but success in this role depends on using it to guide business choices, lead through others and create lasting value for customers. 

What you get to do in this role 

Our Enterprise Industries team serves manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, retail, travel and services customers. You will: 

  • Shape transformation direction. Work with customer leaders to understand their business strategy, economics and operating model. Identify the capabilities that need to change and connect them to measurable customer, employee and operational outcomes. 

  • Lead through complexity and uncertainty. Frame problems before requirements are settled. Navigate competing business-unit priorities, fragmented ownership, legacy investments and delivery constraints to establish a practical direction. 

  • Influence consequential executive decisions. Build trusted relationships with business executives, technology leaders and enterprise architects. Challenge assumptions, evaluate alternatives and secure alignment on priorities, architectural choices and the case for change. 

  • Develop enterprise architectures and roadmaps. Connect current and target states across business capabilities, processes, applications, data and technology. Make sequencing, dependencies, governance, risk and investment trade-offs explicit. 

  • Position ServiceNow within the wider enterprise. Define its role alongside core business systems, cloud services and other enterprise platforms. Explain what should change, what should remain and how the proposed architecture will work across organisational and technology boundaries. 

  • Guide AI-enabled transformation. Identify where AI, automation and more autonomous workflows can create value. Help customers assess data readiness, integration, human oversight, security, governance and operational risk before committing to an approach. 

  • Lead strategic pre-sales engagements. Partner with account leaders, solution consultants, industry specialists and partners to shape complex opportunities, develop compelling propositions and support customer investment decisions in a fast-moving sales environment. 

  • Turn executive working sessions into decisions. Use discovery, human-centred design and architecture workshops to establish a shared understanding, explore options and agree outcomes, priorities and next steps. 

  • Create a credible path to delivery. Work with customer and partner teams to validate assumptions, feasibility and dependencies. Maintain continuity between the transformation proposition, architectural direction and implementation planning, with clear ownership and handoffs. 

  • Lead through others. Align specialists across multiple workstreams, mentor colleagues and strengthen the team’s architectural judgement. Develop reusable approaches, industry perspectives and thought leadership, and share customer insights with relevant ServiceNow teams. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you will bring: 

  • A sustained record of enterprise transformation leadership. Substantial experience in enterprise architecture, technology strategy or transformation consulting, typically developed over 10 or more years. Equivalent experience with demonstrable principal-level impact will also be considered. Your examples should show decisions and outcomes you personally shaped—not just programmes you participated in. 

  • Strategic judgement in complex situations. Evidence of framing ambiguous problems, assessing options and making recommendations where business priorities, technology constraints, investment choices and risks conflict. You can explain both your chosen approach and the alternatives you rejected. 

  • Executive influence and stakeholder alignment. A track record of influencing senior business and technology leaders, handling constructive disagreement and building agreement across organisational boundaries. You can turn architectural analysis into a clear executive recommendation and case for change. 

  • Enterprise-wide architectural depth. Experience shaping target architectures and phased roadmaps across business capabilities, operating models, processes, applications, data and technology. Your work spans multiple systems and functions, rather than a single application domain alone. 

  • Relevant industry depth. Strong experience in at least one of manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, retail, travel or services, with the ability to apply that knowledge across adjacent sectors. You understand how organisations in your sector generate value, serve customers, manage costs and risk, and make investment decisions. Deep expertise in every sector is not expected. 

  • Business-value and investment thinking. Ability to connect architectural choices to commercial and operational outcomes, develop business-case assumptions with relevant specialists, and explain costs, benefits, dependencies and time-to-value. You distinguish credible value hypotheses from unsupported claims. 

  • Customer-facing commercial experience. Experience in strategic pre-sales, consulting, customer-side architecture or transformation delivery, together with the ability to shape opportunities and guide decisions in a sales environment. You balance customer credibility with commercial awareness. 

  • Practical understanding of AI-enabled transformation. Experience assessing or shaping the use of AI in business workflows and decisions. You can evaluate where AI adds value, where it does not, and the implications for data, integration, human accountability, governance and adoption. 

  • Sound technical architecture judgement. Strong understanding of cloud-based applications and platforms, enterprise integration, data architecture, identity, security and resilience. You can assess interoperability, scalability and the practical implications of architecture decisions, drawing on specialists where needed. 

  • Leadership without direct authority. Evidence of setting direction and aligning customers, partners and multidisciplinary teams across complex programmes. You establish decision principles, mentor others and create clarity around ownership and dependencies. 

  • Clear communication and facilitation. Ability to produce compelling executive narratives, decision papers, architecture views and roadmaps. You use discovery and human-centred design to uncover needs and facilitate working sessions that produce agreement and action. 

Relevant knowledge and additional strengths 

The following will strengthen your application. We are interested in how you apply this knowledge, not in collecting every technology or framework listed. 

  • Industry processes and systems. Familiarity with the systems and workflows relevant to your sector. Examples include enterprise resource planning, manufacturing execution, warehouse and supply-chain management, point-of-sale and digital commerce, reservations and service operations. 

  • Industry transformation experience. Work on relevant challenges such as manufacturing resilience and connected operations; supply-chain visibility; omnichannel customer journeys; travel disruption and service recovery; or services productivity and customer experience. 

  • Applied architecture methods. Practical use of enterprise architecture, capability modelling and architecture governance approaches. Examples include TOGAF, ArchiMate and IT4IT, or comparable methods appropriate to the engagement. Relevant supply-chain architecture experience may include SCOR. 

  • Sector-specific risk and regulation. Understanding of the privacy, operational, safety, environmental or other regulatory constraints relevant to your industry, and how they influence transformation choices. 

  • ServiceNow and ecosystem experience. Experience positioning ServiceNow or another enterprise workflow platform within a broader architecture, and working with implementation partners and independent software vendors. Platform-specific expertise complements the strategic capabilities above; it does not substitute for them. 

  • Additional technical depth. Expertise in areas such as AI architecture, analytics, DevOps, digital products or integration between enterprise IT and operational technology, where relevant to customer needs. 

  • Thought leadership and practice development. Evidence of mentoring architects, developing reusable approaches or publishing and presenting perspectives that help customers make better decisions. 

What success looks like 

  • Customer leaders agree on a transformation direction, with clear business outcomes, priorities and architectural choices. 

  • Strategic opportunities are supported by credible enterprise architectures, investment logic and phased roadmaps—not disconnected product proposals. 

  • Customer, partner and ServiceNow teams understand the dependencies, risks and responsibilities needed to move from the proposed direction into delivery. 

  • Your leadership improves the quality of decisions and the effectiveness of others across the account team and architecture community.

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software.

Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are.

Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us.

Job Description

We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support.

Ready to be the person who turns “we’re stuck” into “we’re live”? We’re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next.

Technical Solutions

  • Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow.
  • Build, test, and launch automations with Flow’s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow.
  • Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers.
  • Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery.
  • Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations.

Customer Success and Adoption

  • Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day.
  • Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk.
  • Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery.

Support and Reliability

  • Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed.
  • Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution.
  • Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them.
  • Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully.
  • Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution.

The Context Engine is ServiceNow’s platform for connecting enterprise data, knowledge graphs, and AI workloads into a single, governed context layer. We’re building the data infrastructure that AI agents and applications will depend on as enterprises move from pilots to production.

Types of problems you’ll get to work on
You’ll own the technical architecture of core components across the data lake (Iceberg, Polaris, Trino) and the Context Engine, taking them from early release to real adoption with customers.

Your core focus areas:

  • Platform architecture. Lead design and implementation of lakehouse table services and context graph ingestion. Translate product requirements into scalable, observable plans with clear failure-recovery patterns.
  • LLMs and ontologies. Design how large language models and enterprise ontologies work together in the Context Engine: ontology-grounded retrieval and reasoning for LLMs, and LLM-assisted ontology construction, mapping, and evolution. Make both production-grade, observable, and governed.
  • 1.0 to adoption. Drive the full arc from early release to meaningful adoption. Learn from how customers actually use the platform, not only what they say, and build feedback loops that improve adoption over time.
  • AI-native engineering. Set the bar for using AI in engineering itself, from AI-assisted code review and test generation to platform features that treat AI agents as first-class users.

  • Cross-functional execution. Work with Product, Design, and partner engineering teams to align dependencies and ship coherent experiences.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in software engineering, including shipping complex enterprise-grade data or SaaS products at scale.
  • Hands-on experience building products from zero, with ownership of both code and architecture decisions. Not prototypes.
  • Deep cloud-native architecture: multi-tenant design, large-scale API design (REST/gRPC), Kubernetes, observability, and multi-cloud platforms.
  • Distributed systems and event-driven architecture expertise, with a focus on reliability, fault tolerance, and operational observability.
  • Strong data modeling across relational, graph, columnar, and streaming systems, including open table formats such as Iceberg and query engines such as Trino.

  • Working knowledge of ontologies and semantic modeling (such as OWL, RDF, or SKOS), including how they constrain and ground LLM outputs.
  • Proficiency across the full engineering lifecycle, using AI daily to improve delivery velocity and software quality.
  • Technical influence without formal authority, with a record of driving architecture decisions across teams through clear reasoning.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge graph or context graph experience, including entity resolution and graph query optimization.
  • Experience building ontologies or semantic layers at enterprise scale, including ontology alignment and schema mapping across data sources.
  • Experience fine-tuning or evaluating LLMs for entity extraction, classification, or relation extraction.
  • Data governance, lineage, or catalog product experience, including auditability and access control.
  • Production experience with data pipeline ingestion from SaaS sources.
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI and other AI interoperability standards.

Intelligence is commoditizing. Context and execution are not. title: Staff Software Engineer, Integrations
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About Team

Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 

Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 

Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On the Integrations team, you’ll own how Flow connects to the systems companies run on, including identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat. You’ll turn them into three things: assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run. Every connection keeps each source’s permissions intact. 

In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. 

Types of problems you’ll get to work on 

  • Integration generation at scale. We don’t hand-write connectors. Build the pipeline that generates them from whatever a vendor publishes, which is often not a clean OpenAPI spec — and own spec normalization, pinned provenance, and deterministic regeneration across a growing catalog. 

  • Tool surfaces an AI can actually call. An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. 

  • Permissions and credentials you can prove. If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. 

  • AI-native development itself. Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. 

  • Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code review, and coaching. Partner with product and design to shape requirements and explain tradeoffs clearly. 

Our stack 

TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

  • 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. 

  • Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection.  

  • Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. 

  • Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. 

  • Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. 

  • A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. 

  • Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

  • Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. 

  • Background in IT service management or employee support products. 

Why join us 

Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. 

Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation.

This role goes beyond delivering against a roadmap — you will help define the roadmap itself, using data-driven prioritization and strong product sense to decide what matters most. You'll operate across a wider cross-functional surface area, requiring sharper stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills to align multiple teams and senior partners around a shared direction. 

This role is for someone with proven, hands-on execution experience at scale — not theoretical AI knowledge. We're looking for concrete evidence of AI products you've shipped, the technical and business tradeoffs you navigated, and the cross-functional outcomes you drove, not conceptual familiarity with AI. 

What You'll Own 

  • Strategy and execution for a broad product area to accelerate agent productivity, including defining the roadmap and prioritization framework, not just executing against one. 
  • Data-driven decision-making at scale: using product analytics, experimentation, and usage data to make prioritization calls with meaningful business impact. 
  • High-quality strategy and requirements documents that senior stakeholders and engineering leadership rely on to align and execute. 
  • Cross-functional leadership: aligning multiple teams, engineering, data science, and senior stakeholders around shared priorities, often without direct authority. 
  • Mentorship of more junior product managers, raising the execution and technical bar across the team. 

Why This Role Matters 

  • Broader scope and higher-leverage ownership over how a significant piece of the AI portfolio evolves. 
  • Direct influence on strategy and prioritization decisions with visible impact on business outcomes. 
  • A seat at the table with senior engineering, data science, and product leadership shaping the direction of a fast-scaling AI organization. 

What Success Looks Like 

  • A roadmap and prioritization framework that is data-backed, well-understood by stakeholders, and consistently delivered against. 
  • Strategy and requirements documents that require minimal rework and are trusted by senior technical and business stakeholders. 
  • Demonstrated ability to align and influence senior cross-functional partners without direct authority, resolving competing priorities effectively. 
  • Evidence of raising the bar for more junior PMs through mentorship and modeling strong execution. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 12+ years of product management experience, with recent, hands-on experience enabling and shipping AI or data-powered products at meaningful scale — not just conceptual AI knowledge. 
  • Strong data sense and demonstrated ability to drive prioritization decisions using product analytics and experimentation, with measurable business impact. 
  • Proven ability to write clear, senior-level strategy, requirements, and prioritization documents that stakeholders rely on. 
  • Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills across senior, cross-functional, and sometimes competing priorities. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of aligning diverse technical and business audiences. 
  • A track record of proven execution — specific, verifiable examples of AI products shipped, tradeoffs navigated, and outcomes delivered. 
  • Strong technical fluency; comfortable engaging deeply with engineering on architecture and feasibility tradeoffs. 
  • Experience mentoring or informally guiding more junior product managers is a plus.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description
