Job Description

As a Senior Staff Engineer in HRSD, you set the technical direction for model-driven capability across the HR domain, the agentic and conversational experiences that interpret employee, manager, and HR agent intent, reason over profile, case, catalog, policy, and knowledge context, and act on the user's behalf. Your unit of ownership is the architecture, standards, and evaluation infrastructure that let multiple teams ship those experiences safely — not a single feature set. 

This is not an ML research role; you do not train foundation models. It is also distinct from traditional full-stack staff work, where systems follow deterministic logic. Two things shape the job: much of the load-bearing logic lives in natural language — instructions, prompts, context, tool descriptions, guardrails — and must be engineered with the same discipline as code; and because behavior is probabilistic, correctness is established through evaluation at scale, not fixed assertions. 

What You'll Own 

AI architecture for the domain. How agents are decomposed and composed, where reasoning happens, how context is assembled and bounded, how tools are exposed, and how autonomy is delegated. Own the multi-release calls: model selection and migration, orchestration approach, build-versus-adopt, and the cost/latency/quality tradeoffs behind each. 

The autonomy boundary. Decide as domain policy which HR actions an agent may take, which require a human decision point, and which no agent should attempt. Anything changing pay, employment status, restricted records, or employee-relations matters requires a human in the path by construction — build the mechanisms that make those constraints structural. 

The shared instruction and tool description surface. HRSD ships as product; customers configure, extend, and override this surface on their own instances. Treat it as a versioned contract with upgrade-safe extension points, deprecation paths, and compatibility guarantees. 

Evaluation as infrastructure. Own the golden datasets, multi-turn suites, judge calibration, CI gates, and drift detection that let teams change behavior safely. Extend coverage to HR-specific failure classes: access-boundary violations, cross-scope leakage, jurisdictional and policy-variant correctness. 

Production quality and safety. Observability for containment, hallucination rate, tool-selection error, unsafe action, and injection vectors from user-supplied content entering agent context. Because HR conversation content is itself restricted, design diagnosis that works without exposing what was said. 

AI-assisted engineering standards. Convert ambiguous problems into testable specs; define what accountable agent-assisted delivery looks like for the domain — specification standards, review expectations, verification harnesses — and hold the line on it. 

Hands-on where it matters. The hard integration, the risky migration, the prototype that settles an architectural argument, the incident nobody else can unblock. 

Partner across functions. Collaborate efficiently with product, engineering, design to co-create scalable AI solutions and translate business needs into robust technical designs. 

Qualifications

What You Bring:

7+ years of software engineering, with a record of technical direction adopted beyond your immediate team. 

Direct, hands-on experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation that verifies them. 

Production experience with LLM APIs, retrieval-grounded features, agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement — including at least one model or orchestration migration carried through production. 

Entitlement-aware data handling: per-user access enforcement in retrieval and tool layers, scope separation between roles, and handling of restricted records under audit. 

Evaluation experience used by engineers other than yourself: dataset curation, judge calibration, CI gating, drift detection. 

Strong command of system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing across front-end, server-side, and relational data work with a high quality mindset. 

Effective, accountable use of AI coding assistants and agents. 

On-call and incident-command experience on customer-facing systems, including ownership of the systemic fixes that followed. 

Experience in software stack including Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React and demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools and frameworks. 

Bachelor's degree in CS, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred 

HR domain depth: case management, employee journey and lifecycle, or payroll/benefits/leave/absence sufficient to set requirements. 

Integration with core HR, payroll, or benefits systems of record, including reconciliation and eventual-consistency patterns. 

Contribution in a Forward deployment model to champion customer adoption.

Job Description

About Flow by ServiceNow

Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are.

Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us.

Job Description

We are hiring a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer to be the most senior technical authority for Flow customers, guiding strategic and enterprise accounts from first demo and trial to long-term, expanding success. You will lead the hardest customer deployments, architect solutions that go beyond what the product does today, and turn what you learn in the field into product strategy. You will also raise the bar for the entire forward deployed team by setting technical standards, building repeatable playbooks, and mentoring other engineers. The role combines deep technical implementation, strategic customer partnership, and cross-functional leadership.

Ready to turn “we’re stuck” into “we’re live” for the most complex enterprise environments? You will own outcomes across multiple strategic customers, influence the Flow roadmap, and define how ServiceNow deploys AI-native products in the field.

What You Will Do

Technical Solutions and Architecture

  • Lead technical design and delivery for strategic enterprise deployments, including SSO and identity architecture, multi-system integrations, and security and compliance reviews with customer IT and security leadership.
  • Architect and build complex, production-grade automations and workflows with Flow’s natural-language builder across tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow.
  • Design knowledge and retrieval strategies across document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base, so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers at enterprise scale.
  • Solve problems the product does not yet handle by designing and documenting scalable workarounds, and convert them into reusable patterns, reference architectures, and product capabilities.
  • Lead proof-of-concept and strategic evaluation efforts, partnering with sales and executive stakeholders to demonstrate value and win competitive engagements.

Customer Success and Strategic Adoption

  • Define and continuously improve the onboarding and implementation motion so new customers set up and enable Flow in a few hours and reach production in one day.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer IT directors and executives, aligning Flow with their broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans.
  • Use Flow analytics on usage, conversation allowances, and automation results to build business cases, demonstrate value, and drive expansion from an initial use case to a full self-service service desk.
  • Own multi-account health and adoption outcomes, identifying risks early and driving executive-level resolution when needed.

Product Influence and Technical Leadership

  • Translate patterns across customers into clear product requirements and strategy, and partner with product management and engineering to prioritize and shepherd them through delivery.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer in roadmap, architecture, and go-to-market discussions, shaping how Flow is positioned, packaged, and priced.
  • Establish technical standards, playbooks, and tooling for the forward deployed function, and scale them across teams.
  • Mentor and coach solutions engineers at IC3 and IC4 levels and act as an escalation point for the most difficult issues.

Support and Reliability

  • Serve as the final technical escalation for critical customer issues such as API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, and failed automations, and drive them from diagnosis to durable resolution.
  • Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them, including systemic issues affecting multiple customers.
  • Use Flow health, audit, and activity logs to diagnose complex issues, identify outages, and define monitoring and triage practices that improve reliability for all customers.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software, including experience leading strategic, multi-system deployments.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with the ability to design integration architectures and debug them at depth.
  • Expert knowledge of single sign-on and identity architectures, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID, and of enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Extensive experience with enterprise service management or collaboration platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
  • Strong understanding of AI and workflow automation, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, and evaluating the quality and accuracy of AI answers.
  • Proven ability to communicate and influence from system administrators and security engineers to IT directors and executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect customer outcomes to broader IT and operations strategy and to ServiceNow’s plans.
  • Track record of technical leadership and mentorship, and of influencing product direction and cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Preferred 

  • Experience with service desk offerings.
  • Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products.
  • Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software.
  • Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion, playbooks, or a forward deployed function from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

As a CRM Solution Consultant for the UKI market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The CRM Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the CRM Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 

  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 

  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 

  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 

  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 

  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 

  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 

  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 

  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 

  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 

  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 

  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 

  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 

  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 

  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 

  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 

Qualifications 

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 

  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 

  • 6+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. 

  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. 

  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. 

  • Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities.

The Senior CRM Sales Specialist, CPQ will drive market success of ServiceNow’s Configure Price Quote (CPQ) and CRM Sales solutions. These solutions sit alongside our market-leading Service Management platform and unify the selling motion by giving sellers a single source of truth for products, pricing, quoting, and deal execution.

What you get to do in this role:

The Senior CRM Sales Specialist for CPQ leads the full sales cycle for our CPQ and CRM Sales products, partnering closely with Solution Consulting, Product, and GTM teams. Responsibilities and activities may vary depending on territory, industry coverage, or account segmentation.

  • Support territory strategy and planning by aligning CPQ/CRM capabilities to account priorities, whitespace, and revenue opportunities
  • Lead discovery with customers to understand quoting challenges, product complexity, approval workflows, and seller inefficiencies
  • Provide strategic input during account planning by identifying CPQ, quoting automation, or CRM workflow modernization use cases
  • Ensure recommendations into account strategy are aligned with Now Value principles, quantifying business impact, efficiency gains, and AI-powered selling outcomes
  • Partner with SC & Specialist SC teams to define roadmap alignment and ensure product fit, capability validation, and competitive positioning
  • Coach AEs, BDRs, and account teams on CPQ/CRM opportunity triggers, value messaging, and how to position workflow automation within the broader selling motion
  • Lead the full sales cycle including qualification, value-based selling, demonstrations, business case development, and negotiation
  • Customize your time to the needs of the territory and account team while celebrating wins across the organization
  • Champion diversity and belonging to contribute to an open and inclusive environment

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Deep experience in specialist sales, preferably within a CRM / CPQ/ Customer engagement/Customer Service Management / CX / CPaaS / CCaaS / SOM vendor
  • 8+ years of sales experience within complex software or platform solutions, selling CPQ, CRM, or Revenue/Sales Operations-related solutions
  • An understanding of the CRM, CX, CSM, or CPQ  solution-related business processes
  • Technical fluency to be able to present, demo and lead credible discovery, value positioning, and use case identification with executives, ServiceNow sellers, and CRM leaders. 
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Experience leading virtual or matrixed teams
  • Ability to understand broad, macro-level business IT needs for a prospective client
  • Experience establishing trusted relationships with current and prospective clients and other teams
  • Ability to produce new business, negotiate deals, and maintain healthy C-Level relationships
  • Able to thrive in a fast paced, growing, deadline driven environment
  • Willingness to go above and beyond to win in the market against stiff competition
  • Ability to communicate complex issues in simple terms via written and oral media, to a variety of different audiences
  • Ability to forge strong business relationships and connect with both C-level execs at customers as well as with individuals in ServiceNow internal and external eco-system
  • Excellent communication and polished presentation skills
  • Regional travel required, office in Milan or Rome with regular attendance expected
  • Fluency in Italian and English essential

The role of CRM Specialist Account Executive, CPQ is subject to the National Collective Bargaining Agreement of Trade Sector (CCNL) and will be classified as QUADRO. For such role we offer an initial gross base pay of EUR [68,550 to 113,100]. This role will also be eligible for the Company's corporate bonus, MBO, or commission incentive leading to a target gross annual OTE of EUR [137,100 to 226,200] and whose specific amount depends on the company and individual performance and is determined in accordance with company's plans from time to time in force and which the company may change in the course of the employment and of which you will be informed in advance.  Please note that the final compensation will be determined during the offer process based on the candidate's experience, skills, competence, qualifications and work location in relation to the offered position, as well as relevant indications from the CCNL, applying objective and gender-neutral criteria. ServiceNow also provides a competitive benefits package that supports employees' health, financial wellbeing, family life, and work-life balance. Benefits include generous paid leave, meal vouchers, employee share purchase opportunities, comprehensive insurance coverage, and access to wellbeing, mental health, and family-forming support programs.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About This Role

Technology companies sell complex products to demanding customers. They are often the first to put AI to work in service. Software vendors, hyperscalers, hardware makers and managed service providers all need to support customers at scale, across products, partners and channels. As a Senior Advisory Solution Consultant on our ANZ CRM & Industry Workflows team, you’ll help them rethink how they sell, serve and support on ServiceNow.

This role leads our CRM specialist coverage for the technology sector across Australia. You’ll work with ISVs, SaaS companies, hyperscalers and hardware manufacturers. You’ll also work with the system integrators, MSPs and consulting firms that partner with us. You’ll join a collaborative, pooled team and, as one of its senior members, help shape how we win in technology.

What You Get to Do

  • Lead the technology segment: Lead CRM pursuits across software, hardware and cloud companies, from first discovery through to technical win. Work with Account Executives and field Solution Consultants on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Lead discovery and shape solutions: Turn business challenges into transformation strategies on ServiceNow’s platform. Think a SaaS company scaling B2B support across regions, a hardware maker modernising field service and returns, or an MSP unifying service delivery for its own clients.
  • Build and demonstrate: Design and deliver demonstrations that combine Customer & Industry Workflows with partner technologies, AI agents and automation. Configure demo environments, stand up lightweight POCs, wire integrations and style portal experiences. You need to be comfortable building things that work and fixing them when they don’t.
  • Sell to partners with care: Many of the SIs, MSPs and consulting firms you’ll work with are also ServiceNow partners. Work alongside our partner team so each relationship stays strong on both sides.
  • Become the voice on technology CX: Build solution frameworks, reference architectures and go-to-market plays for the sector. Present at industry events and partner briefings.
  • Influence account strategy: Partner with Sales and Executive Sponsors to shape long-term account strategies. Engage Chief Customer Officers, CIOs and heads of support and customer success as a trusted advisor.
  • Set delivery up to succeed: Work with partners and our delivery teams so what we sell lands well with the customer.
  • Build ecosystem relationships: Connect with Product Management, technology partners and consulting firms to advocate for technology customers and stay ahead of market shifts.
  • Mentor and strengthen the team: Coach Solution Consultants in solution design, storytelling and value articulation. Build reusable assets that lift the whole pre-sales organisation.

Why Join Us

ServiceNow is one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. You’ll get a whole sector to shape, with AI already live in customer conversations. You’ll join a team that collaborates rather than competes. We invest in your growth through certifications, mentoring and peer networks. You’ll have flexibility and trust in how you work, competitive pay with salary, variable incentives and equity, and the autonomy to bring your own thinking to complex problems.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 10+ years in pre-sales solution consulting, sales engineering or a related technical advisory role. Ideally focused on customer service, customer success or field service in the technology sector.
  • A real understanding of how technology companies run service and growth. Support tiers, customer success and renewals, partner and channel models, and the economics of managed services.
  • A solid technical foundation. You understand how front-ends, back-ends, APIs and data fit together well enough to build POC integrations and reason about where things break. You work productively with AI-assisted development.
  • Proficiency with ServiceNow (particularly CSM, FSM and Sales and Order Management) or equivalent hands-on depth on Salesforce, Dynamics, Zendesk or similar. What matters is that you’ve built and configured things yourself.
  • A track record of leading complex pursuits end to end, including competitive displacements and executive engagement.
  • Experience applying AI and automation to business workflows. Virtual agents, intelligent routing, process automation or AI-driven insights.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to hold your own with deeply technical buyers through to executive leadership.
  • Experience mentoring other consultants, a collaborative mindset, pipeline discipline, and availability to travel across Australia as the role requires.

Also Valuable

Experience working in or for a software company, hyperscaler, systems integrator or MSP. ServiceNow or related certifications. Background in contact centre, field service or CRM transformation. A track record in thought leadership.

title: Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

A solution architect designs and validates how specific ServiceNow solutions will meet the customer’s business and industry requirements. The SA brings deep product and industry knowledge and translates the EA’s enterprise direction into workable solution designs for priority use cases.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Own solution design for key ServiceNow solutions, such as SecOps, TechOps, AI Control Tower, and Employee Works with HRSD or S2P within the customer’s enterprise architecture
  • Run technical discovery, solution workshops, and proof-of-value engagements, and produce solution architecture documents, integration designs, and reference architectures.
  • Validate technical feasibility, scalability, security, and data design with customer architects and engineering teams.
  • Align the ServiceNow platform strategy with the customer’s wider technology estate, including ERP, cloud, data platforms, and third-party AI.
  • Feed field learnings, customer patterns, and reusable assets back to the EA and product teams.

Working relationships:

  • Solution Consultants (SCs): Partner with SCs to shape the enterprise architecture narrative in pursuits, validate target-state recommendations, and align solution scope with the account strategy. The EA provides architectural direction and governance; the SC leads day-to-day solution positioning.
  • Specialists: Engage product and industry specialists to validate platform capabilities, roadmap alignment, and emerging AI and workflow offerings before they are included in target-state designs.
  • Account Sales Executives (AEs): Work with AEs to identify architecture-led opportunities, plan executive engagements, and sequence architecture decisions against deal timelines and buying cycles.
  • Customer stakeholders: Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects, and business sponsors. Facilitate design authority sessions, executive briefings, and architecture workshops that lead to shared decisions.

Industry focus: Each SA aligns to one or more priority industries(FSI, Telco, Public Sector) in Asia, building deep vertical expertise and reusable industry solution patterns.

Qualifications

 To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 7 or more years in solution architecture, technical solution consulting, or implementation delivery, with hands-on experience on enterprise ServiceNow or comparable workflow platforms/solutions
  • Experience designing solutions for at least one priority industry(FSI, Telco, Public sector), with a track record of reusable industry patterns or accelerators
  • Background in pre-sales or technical roles, including pursuit support, technical validation, and proof-of-value delivery
  • Certifications such as ServiceNow Certified Application Developer, Certified System Administrator, or Certified Implementation Specialist, where applicable, plus relevant cloud or integration credentials
  • Experience working across Asia markets, with the ability to engage both regional and local customer teams
  • Deep product expertise across the ServiceNow portfolio, including workflow automation, AI, and platform capabilities
  • Solution design, integration architecture, and API-based integration patterns
  • Industry business process knowledge in one or more priority verticals
  • Technical discovery, solution workshops, and requirements translation
  • Proof-of-value design, delivery oversight, and success measurement
  • Demo and presentation skills for technical and business audiences
  • Competitive positioning and technical objection handling

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

As an Advisory Solution Consultant, Sales CRM for the German market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of an Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant, Sales CRM inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the Advisory Solution ConsultantSales CRM, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 

  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 

  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 

  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 

  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 

  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 

  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 

  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 

  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 

  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

What We’re Looking For 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 

  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 

  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 

  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 

  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 

  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 

  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 

  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 

  • 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. 

  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions.

  • Knowledge of CPQ and Order Management.  

  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. 

  • Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities.

This is an Advisory technical Architect role focused on helping partners build differentiated AI-powered solutions on the ServiceNow platform - from agent architecture and model selection through RAG design, multimodal AI, and AI-first solution commercialization - with particular depth in Moveworks, EmployeeWorks, and Agent Studio. 

As a Practice-aligned Advisor Partner Technical Architect within the AI Platform & Data Practice, you will be engaged where deep AI expertise is required - working alongside partner-aligned Partner Technology Architects and Partner Solution Engineers to shape commercially viable, technically excellent AI solutions. Your focus is on how to architect and design AI solutions that partners build - not how to govern AI at the enterprise level (which is owned by the Partner Technology Architect - Governance & Security through AI Control Tower). 

Your expertise extends beyond ServiceNow capabilities to encompass the full AI ecosystem - foundation models, open-source frameworks, competing platforms - enabling you to guide partners on hybrid architectures and multi-vendor AI strategies that position ServiceNow as the enterprise AI platform of choice. 

What you get to do in this role: 

As an Advisor Partner Technology Architect - AI Platform & Data, you will serve as the go-to AI architecture expert across the partner ecosystem, driving deep technical co-innovation and commercial success for AI-powered partner solutions, and as the Moveworks technical authority for partners in your region. 

AI Architecture & Solution Co-Creation 

  • Co-create AI-native architectures with partners, developing reference architectures, reusable patterns, and integration libraries that partners can extend and monetize. 

  • Provide L400-level expertise in agentic AI architectures including autonomous agent design, multi-agent orchestration, tool use patterns, and human-in-the-loop design patterns. 

  • Drive collaborative adoption of emerging AI technologies across agent frameworks, RAG architectures, multimodal AI, and foundation model integration. 

  • Build reusable co-innovation assets including solution templates, starter kits, scripts, demo environments, and vertical-specific architecture blueprints that enable partners and validate feasibility. Partners own delivery. 

  • Influence AI product architecture and roadmap based on partner ecosystem needs through formal feedback loops with product teams. 

Moveworks Specialization 

  • Serve as the dee[ technical authority on Moveworks and EmployeeWorks for partners in your region, with command of platform internals, Agent Studio, integration patterns, and supported architectures. 

  • Guide partners through integration design with enterprise systems (ITSM, HCM, ERP, CRM), including authentication and data flows. Prototype and test approaches to validate feasibility, including when documentation is incomplete or a first approach fails. 

  • Enable partners to technically qualify, scope, position, and design Moveworks solutions independently, and to deploy EmployeeWorks and win new logos through partner-led motions. 

  • Route Moveworks product feedback and partner questions through the designated PTAG Moveworks lead, who holds the interface to the Moveworks business unit. 

  • Turn recurring partner issues and resolved problems into playbooks, reference architectures, and enablement content, and surface them to the Partner Design Studio for Pattern Library review. 

Pipeline & Revenue Growth

  • Execute strategic proofs of concept that prove AI business value and technical feasibility; deliver standard and tailored product demonstrations showcasing Now Assist, AI Agents, Moveworks, and platform AI capabilities. 

  • Remove technical obstacles at critical deal milestones; guide partners on competitive AI positioning and validate joint solution feasibility. 

  • Present AI architecture and strategy to executive audiences; facilitate cross-functional alignment across technical and business teams. 

Partner AI Capability Building 

  • Design and deliver comprehensive AI architecture training programs, workshops, office hours, and executive briefings that build lasting partner capability in AI solution development.

  • Guide partners from AI concept to validated solution to scalable commercialization with clear monetization pathways.

At the heart of the opportunity is the AI-powered CPQ technology ServiceNow acquired with Logik.ai, designed to transform complex configuration, pricing and quoting and connect it with the broader opportunity-to-order-to-service lifecycle. [newsroom.s...icenow.com], [servicenow.com]

Your mandate

Build a $10M+ qualified business.

You will:

  • Create the market. Identify the countries, industries and 20 strategic accounts where we can win.
  • Create demand. Build executive-level conversations around revenue growth, sales productivity, complex configuration, pricing, quoting and order execution.
  • Build the ecosystem. Identify and mobilize the partners capable of creating reach, credibility and scale.

  • Build something sustainable. Leave behind a repeatable business, not simply a collection of individual deals.

30 days: Market thesis, priority countries and industries, target-account strategy and partner landscape.

60 days: 20-account attack plan, activated account teams and partners, executive conversations underway.

90 days: Material qualified pipeline with clear customer problems, compelling use cases and paths to value.

180 days: A credible trajectory toward $10M+ qualified pipeline, lighthouse opportunities progressing and a repeatable growth engine established across CH, AT and CEE.

We are deliberately not limiting the search to traditional enterprise software sales profiles.

You may be:

  • A senior enterprise seller who has built markets rather than simply managed territories.
  • A business development leader who knows how to create new revenue streams across multiple countries.
  • A commercial or sourcing leader from a large multinational who understands complex products, pricing, channels and transformation from the customer's side.
  • A startup founder or early-stage leader who has taken a business from zero to scale.
  • A CPQ/CRM expert who understands the market and now wants a much bigger canvas.

What matters most is a builder mentality.

You know how to go from a blank sheet of paper to a market strategy, from a market strategy to executive conversations, and from those conversations to qualified pipeline and revenue.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to build new business, not just manage existing pipeline.
  • Strong enterprise commercial acumen and credibility with senior executives.
  • Experience operating across multiple markets, ideally Switzerland, Austria and/or CEE.
  • The ability to orchestrate account executives, solution teams, partners and executives without needing direct control of those resources.

Logik.ai brought a modern, AI-powered and composable CPQ capability into ServiceNow's CRM portfolio, aimed at helping enterprises address complex configuration, pricing, manual quoting and disconnected approval processes. [newsroom.s...icenow.com]

ServiceNow's ambition extends beyond conventional CPQ: sell, fulfill and service on one platform, connecting the commercial lifecycle from opportunity and quoting through order, fulfillment, renewal and expansion. [newsroom.s...icenow.com]

title: Associate Agentic Search Infrastructure Engineer - Moveworks
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

  • Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
  • Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
  • Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
  • Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. Represent each modality so it is retrievable through a unified surface, letting agents find the right material regardless of its form or source.
  • Contribute to a knowledge graph that resolves entities across enterprise data sources, letting agents link disparate resources such as tickets, files, and people through canonical entity relationships.
  • Improve the performance, scalability, and observability of search, including query latency, indexing throughput, and cluster health, to deliver low-latency, high-quality agentic search experiences. Apply techniques such as vector quantization to balance model quality, retrieval performance, and storage cost.
  • Own search infrastructure end to end, from intake and design through rollout and ongoing operations, and help shape the search roadmap as the platform grows to support new agents, primitives, and recipes, including needs not yet anticipated.
  • Drive reliability and operability across the platform through index lifecycle policies, capacity planning, and cluster scaling strategies that keep a growing library of reusable search capabilities healthy in production.

This is a highly collaborative, in-person role, working cross-functionally with Search Ranking, ML, and Platform engineering teams to deliver robust, production-grade agentic search capabilities.

Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or an equivalent engineering background; PhD is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with search technologies; proficiency in one or more search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch is required, with additional experience in vector databases being an advantage.
  • Excited to be part of an in-person team culture, collaborating on-site with colleagues every day.

Internship Program Overview   

At ServiceNow, we’re looking for students who want to learn, grow, and take a giant step early in their careers, all while making a giant impact. We offer 12-week summer internship opportunities across various business functions.    

Interns will participate in executive speaker series, career development workshops, philanthropic efforts, and team-building activities. Additionally, interns will have access to online learnings and a dedicated summer coach to further grow their careers with us.   

If you want to make work, work better, we want you. To learn more, check out our Early Career Page!   

Product Team Overview 

We are looking for full-time MBA students to join our Product Management team at ServiceNow. As a Product Manager, you will work on complex high-tech problems by undertaking research, designing, and executing analysis, and helping frame and structure complex problems. You will work closely with other team members and stakeholders to accelerate our impact and directly contribute to our overall business strategy. This is an excellent opportunity if you are looking to get a taste of product management at a high-growth enterprise software company!      

Product Management is a team sport at ServiceNow. We have a unique organization structure in which multiple Product Management roles work together to contribute to a product’s success.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About Team

Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 

Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 

Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On the Integrations team, you’ll own how Flow connects to the systems companies run on, including identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat. You’ll turn them into three things: assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run. Every connection keeps each source’s permissions intact. 

In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. 

Types of problems you’ll get to work on 

  • Integration generation at scale. We don’t hand-write connectors. Build the pipeline that generates them from whatever a vendor publishes, which is often not a clean OpenAPI spec — and own spec normalization, pinned provenance, and deterministic regeneration across a growing catalog. 

  • Tool surfaces an AI can actually call. An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. 

  • Permissions and credentials you can prove. If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. 

  • AI-native development itself. Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. 

  • Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code review, and coaching. Partner with product and design to shape requirements and explain tradeoffs clearly. 

Our stack 

TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

  • 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. 

  • Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection.  

  • Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. 

  • Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. 

  • Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. 

  • A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. 

  • Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

  • Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. 

  • Background in IT service management or employee support products. 

Why join us 

Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. 

Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Job Description

Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

  • Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
  • Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
  • Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
  • Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. Represent each modality so it is retrievable through a unified surface, letting agents find the right material regardless of its form or source.
  • Contribute to a knowledge graph that resolves entities across enterprise data sources, letting agents link disparate resources such as tickets, files, and people through canonical entity relationships.
  • Improve the performance, scalability, and observability of search, including query latency, indexing throughput, and cluster health, to deliver low-latency, high-quality agentic search experiences. Apply techniques such as vector quantization to balance model quality, retrieval performance, and storage cost.
  • Own search infrastructure end to end, from intake and design through rollout and ongoing operations, and help shape the search roadmap as the platform grows to support new agents, primitives, and recipes, including needs not yet anticipated.
  • Drive reliability and operability across the platform through index lifecycle policies, capacity planning, and cluster scaling strategies that keep a growing library of reusable search capabilities healthy in production.

This is a highly collaborative, in-person role, working cross-functionally with Search Ranking, ML, and Platform engineering teams to deliver robust, production-grade agentic search capabilities.

Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or an equivalent engineering background; PhD is a plus.
  • 2+ years of full-time industry experience.

Job Description

As Director of Monetization & Packaging Strategy for the EmployeeWorks Business Unit, you’ll own how our AI products are monetized, packaged, and brought to market. You’ll partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and executive leadership to turn pricing into a growth lever, building models and offers that drive acquisition, expand existing customers, and protect retention. This role sits at the center of product strategy and go-to-market, and it shapes how customers experience the value of EmployeeWorks from first deal through renewal. 

What you’ll do 

Pricing strategy development and innovation 

  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and executives to build pricing models for every new or repackaged SKU. 

  • Partner with ServiceNow’s central pricing team to keep EmployeeWorks pricing and packaging aligned with company-wide pricing strategy. 

  • Develop and maintain pricing strategies that align with BU and company objectives, grounded in primary research, financial modeling, stakeholder interviews, and competitive research. 

  • Design pricing, bundling, and offer strategies, along with the sales plays that bring them to market, to maximize customer acquisition, retention, and revenue. 

Consumption pricing strategy 

  • Own the consumption pricing strategy for the BU, including setting the rate card for Assist consumption. 

  • Propose rate card and consumption pricing changes in partnership with the central pricing team. 

  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering on Assist metering telemetry, so usage is measured accurately and billed consistently. 

  • Drive token spend analysis and optimization to protect margins as customer usage scales. 

  • Own consumption tracking, analysis, and insights for the business, turning usage trends into pricing, packaging, and forecasting decisions. 

Go-to-market alignment 

  • Align monetization efforts across Sales, Marketing, and post-sales success teams so pricing translates into revenue and retention. 

  • Build and maintain a centralized pricing excellence hub that equips sales and renewals teams to price with confidence. 

  • Help sales build glide paths to different SKU options that drive upsells and renewals. 

  • Manage pricing strategy across direct, partner, and reseller channels, ensuring consistent execution and profitability across all of them, including third-party partnerships. 

Insights and analytics 

  • Build frameworks to monitor pricing performance and present insights and recommendations to senior leadership. 

  • Create financial models and analyses to assess the impact of pricing decisions, and design experiments to test pricing hypotheses. 

Competitive intelligence and market analysis 

  • Lead pricing research, including competitor analysis and market benchmarking, to keep EmployeeWorks competitively positioned. 

Qualifications

What you bring to the table 

  • 7+ years of experience in pricing strategy, product monetization, or financial analysis, ideally in SaaS or AI. 

  • Deep expertise in financial modeling, revenue optimization, and strategic analysis. 

  • A track record of pricing decisions that delivered measurable business impact. 

  • Strong leadership presence and experience influencing senior stakeholders toward business outcomes. 

  • Proven operator in cross-functional environments: strong prioritization instincts, able to build consensus and drive results without direct authority. 

  • Strong judgment about when to act independently and when to escalate, with the ability to navigate ambiguity. 

  • Comfort operating in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment. 

  • Proven ability to thrive in a highly dynamic environment where written guides and playbooks are sparse and changes occur nearly daily: you create structure where none exists, ramp quickly, ask sharp questions, stay current without being told, and keep partners and leadership aligned as things shift. 

  • Excellent communication skills, with a talent for making complex pricing concepts clear to non-financial audiences. 

  • Fluency in AI, with the ability to translate engineering and product concepts for non-technical stakeholders and represent EmployeeWorks products to central pricing, product management, and GTM teams.

ServiceNow is looking for driven, ambitious candidates to join our Global Business Acceleration Internship Program. This program focuses on exposure to core prospecting and outreach techniques that engage buying group members and develop foundational knowledge of ServiceNow.

Global Business Acceleration’s mission is to drive high-quality pipeline that fuels predictable growth. We pioneer AI and innovation to transform go-to-market strategies with precision. We are the launch pad for top talent to develop into the leaders of tomorrow at ServiceNow.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Build strong relationships and collaborate across Sales and Marketing teams in a dynamic, structured program
  • Engages current and future customers through phone, email, and social to connect with key contacts using approved messaging and defined qualification criteria
  • Drive outreach within target accounts - Identify and engage new buying group members, validate signals and intent, and create personalized experiences at scale to deliver high quality pipeline opportunities
  • Keep the right buying group members engaged across the opportunity by orchestrating meetings with customers and prospects for the Sales team
  • Leverage cutting-edge technology to unlock deeper relationships, accelerate momentum, and help close bigger deals
  • Gain hands-on experience with ServiceNow solutions, learning how they solve real customer challenges
  • Have consistent engagement and collaboration with the Global Business Acceleration management team, Enablement team and Go-To-Market team(s)
  • Present a final project to leadership, showcasing your impact and learnings

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you should have:

  • Enrolled as a full-time student and will graduate 2028.
  • Eligible candidates must be studying their bachelors.
  • Available to commit to a full-time 12-week internship program June 2027 and to work in a hybrid capacity.
  • High motivation, curiosity, and openness to coaching and feedback.
  • A resilient work ethic; reliable, confident, collaborative, driven, and coachable
  • Foundational knowledge of Cloud computing and SaaS offerings, or willingness to learn
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to learn and apply standard outreach and qualification practices
  • Interest in building customer relationships, qualifying opportunities, and contributing to early-stage pipeline that drives company revenue
  • Willingness to learn AI-native tools and innovate on how they’re used to enhance outreach, prioritization, and daily workflows
  • Willingness to fully participate in development simulations, in-person messaging activities, and meet defined performance expectations
  • We’re hiring across several language markets and would love to hear from candidates who speak Native/Fluent Dutch, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Swedish, Spanish, Italian, Swedish, Arabic OR French.

Job Description

Job Description 

The CRM Account Executive will oversee market success of ServiceNow's CRM suite of products. You will play a leading role in engaging assigned accounts and be responsible for the creation of new business and pipeline across a substantial portion of the ServiceNow sales cycle and methodology. You will oversee executive relationship management for assigned accounts; lead and partner with virtual teams, including Core Field, Solution Sales, Solution Consulting, Support and Professional Services. 

What you will get to do in this role: 

  • Oversee worldwide development of assigned accounts, including development and deployment of territory resources 

  • Develop a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan for your assigned account and/or territory. 

  • Develop relationships with multiple C-suite personas (e.g., CFO, CIO, COO, CDO) across CRM product(s) and CRM multi-workflow solution(s). 

  • Arrange and conduct initial Executive and CxO discussions and position meetings 

  • Collaborate closely with your Solution Consulting counterpart and extended team to deliver ‘art of the possible’ demonstrations showcasing ServiceNow’s CRM product(s) & solution(s), orchestrating relationships as required. 

  • Develop a clear roadmap and building capabilities across our clients and ServiceNow teams to promote an outstanding customer experience 

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future Customer Engagement & Operations roadmap to drive the ServiceNow CRM platform 

  • Own and Lead CRM opportunities all the while collaborating closely with Core Sales Teams (AE’s, SC’s, Leadership) and other ServiceNow Solution Areas (Creator, Employee, Technology) to deliver outcomes-based solutions to our clients and prospects. 

  • In partnership with assigned Account Executive and Solution Consultant, present our CRM offering directly to prospects, customers, partners and at industry events and seminars 

  • Articulate customer success strategies to the field to streamline and standardize Platform presentations and value proposition 

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams with limited support from inside sales 

  • Sales process management and opportunity closure 

  • Ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and drive additional revenue streams 

Qualifications

Qualifications 

To be successful in this role you have: 

  • Deep experience in an Account Executive role, preferably within a CRM / Customer engagement /Customer Service Management /  CX / CPaaS / CCaaS / SOM vendor

title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities.

You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. 

The Embedded Approach 

The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. 

What You’ll Do 

As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. 
  • Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. 
  • Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. 
  • Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. 
  • Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. 
  • Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. 
  • Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. 
  • Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. 
  • Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. 
  • Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. 

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For 

To succeed in this role, you should bring: 

  • Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. 
  • POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. 
  • Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. 
  • Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. 
  • CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. 
  • Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. 
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. 
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. 
  • Language: fluency in English and French/German 

Qualifications 

  • Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. 
  • Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 
  • 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. 
  • Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. 
  • Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. 
  • Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities.
